ko.title: 금은 왜 계속해서 구매자를 끌어들이는가: 중앙은행, 개인 투자자, 그리고 안전 자산으로서의 매력

segments.src: Gold has stayed in the spotlight in recent years.
segments.tr: 최근 몇 년간 금은 계속해서 주목을 받아왔습니다.

segments.src: Investors are weighing persistent inflation worries, high government debt and geopolitical tension.
segments.tr: 투자자들은 지속적인 인플레이션 우려, 높은 정부 부채, 지정학적 긴장 상황을 저울질하고 있습니다.

segments.src: Each of these tends to push people toward assets they see as durable.
segments.tr: 이러한 요인들은 사람들을 내구성이 있다고 판단되는 자산으로 이끄는 경향이 있습니다.

segments.src: This article explains what moves the price of gold, who is buying, and what the metal can and can't do in a portfolio.
segments.tr: 이 기사에서는 금 가격을 움직이는 요인, 금을 구매하는 주체, 그리고 금이 포트폴리오에서 할 수 있는 역할과 할 수 없는 역할에 대해 설명합니다.

segments.src: *This article is for general information only.
segments.tr: *이 기사는 일반적인 정보 제공만을 목적으로 합니다.

segments.src: It is not investment, tax or legal advice.*
segments.tr: 투자, 세무 또는 법률 자문이 아닙니다.*

segments.src: ## Why gold is called a "safe haven"
segments.tr: ## 금이 "안전 자산(safe haven)"이라 불리는 이유

segments.src: A safe haven is an asset that investors expect to hold its value, or at least hold up better than most, when markets are stressed.
segments.tr: 안전 자산이란 시장이 불안정할 때 투자자들이 가치를 유지하거나, 적어도 다른 대부분의 자산보다 더 잘 버틸 것으로 기대하는 자산을 말합니다.

segments.src: Gold has earned that reputation for several reasons:
segments.tr: 금은 여러 가지 이유로 이러한 명성을 얻었습니다:

segments.src: - **It has a long history as a store of value.** Societies have used it as money and as a form of savings for thousands of years.
segments.tr: - **오랜 기간 가치 저장 수단으로 사용되었습니다.** 인류는 수천 년 동안 금을 화폐이자 저축의 형태로 사용해 왔습니다.

segments.src: - **It is no one's liability.** A bond depends on its issuer's ability to pay. A bank deposit depends on the bank. Physical gold doesn't depend on any borrower's promise.
segments.tr: - **누구의 부채도 아닙니다.** 채권은 발행자의 상환 능력에 의존합니다. 은행 예금은 은행에 의존합니다. 실물 금은 차입자의 약속에 의존하지 않습니다.

segments.src: - **Its supply grows slowly.** Mining adds only a small share to the above-ground stock each year, so it is hard to expand quickly the way a currency can be.
segments.tr: - **공급이 천천히 증가합니다.** 채굴을 통해 매년 지상에 존재하는 금의 양이 조금씩 늘어날 뿐이므로, 통화처럼 빠르게 공급량을 늘리기 어렵습니다.

segments.src: - **It is widely recognized.** It is traded around the clock in many countries and currencies.
segments.tr: - **널리 인정받습니다.** 많은 국가와 통화로 24시간 내내 거래됩니다.

segments.src: The label has limits.
segments.tr: 이러한 명칭에도 한계는 있습니다.

segments.src: Gold has had long stretches, and sharp drops, when it did not behave like a haven.
segments.tr: 금은 안전 자산처럼 행동하지 않았던 긴 기간과 급격한 하락세를 겪기도 했습니다.

segments.src: "Safe" here means "has often held up in a crisis," not "can't lose value."
segments.tr: 여기서 "안전"이란 "가치가 떨어질 수 없다"는 뜻이 아니라 "위기 상황에서 종종 가치를 방어했다"는 의미입니다.

segments.src: ## What drives the price
segments.tr: ## 가격을 움직이는 요인

segments.src: No single factor sets the price of gold.
segments.tr: 단 하나의 요인이 금 가격을 결정하지는 않습니다.

segments.src: Analysts usually point to a handful of forces that interact.
segments.tr: 분석가들은 보통 상호작용하는 몇 가지 힘을 지목합니다.

segments.src: ### Real interest rates
segments.tr: ### 실질 금리

segments.src: Gold pays no interest or dividends.
segments.tr: 금은 이자나 배당금을 지급하지 않습니다.

segments.src: When inflation-adjusted yields on government bonds are high, holding gold has a bigger opportunity cost, and prices often come under pressure.
segments.tr: 인플레이션을 반영한 국채 수익률이 높을 때 금을 보유하는 것은 더 큰 기회비용을 의미하며, 가격은 종종 압박을 받습니다.

segments.src: When real yields fall or turn negative, gold tends to look more attractive.
segments.tr: 실질 수익률이 하락하거나 마이너스로 돌아서면 금은 더 매력적으로 보이는 경향이 있습니다.

segments.src: ### The U.S. dollar
segments.tr: ### 미국 달러

segments.src: Gold is priced mainly in dollars.
segments.tr: 금은 주로 달러로 가격이 책정됩니다.

segments.src: A weaker dollar generally makes gold cheaper for buyers using other currencies, which can lift demand.
segments.tr: 달러 약세는 일반적으로 다른 통화를 사용하는 구매자에게 금을 더 저렴하게 만들어 수요를 끌어올릴 수 있습니다.

segments.src: A stronger dollar often has the opposite effect.
segments.tr: 달러 강세는 종종 반대의 효과를 냅니다.

segments.src: The relationship is not exact, but it is a common reference point.
segments.tr: 이 관계가 정확히 일치하는 것은 아니지만, 흔히 참고하는 기준점입니다.

segments.src: ### Inflation and debt concerns
segments.tr: ### 인플레이션 및 부채 우려

segments.src: When people worry that rising prices or growing public debt could erode the purchasing power of money, some turn to gold as a hedge.
segments.tr: 물가 상승이나 공공 부채 증가가 화폐의 구매력을 약화시킬 수 있다고 우려할 때, 일부는 헤지(위험 회피) 수단으로 금을 찾습니다.

segments.src: What matters is often the *expectation* of inflation, not the latest reading.
segments.tr: 중요한 것은 최근의 수치가 아니라 인플레이션에 대한 *기대*인 경우가 많습니다.

segments.src: Over short periods, gold has not tracked inflation closely.
segments.tr: 단기적으로 금은 인플레이션을 밀접하게 추종하지 않았습니다.

segments.src: ### Geopolitical and financial stress
segments.tr: ### 지정학적 및 금융적 스트레스

segments.src: Wars, sanctions, banking scares and political uncertainty can send investors looking for assets outside the traditional financial system.
segments.tr: 전쟁, 제재, 은행 위기, 정치적 불확실성은 투자자들이 전통적인 금융 시스템 밖의 자산을 찾게 만들 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Demand driven by fear can arrive quickly and fade just as fast.
segments.tr: 공포에 의한 수요는 빠르게 나타났다가 그만큼 빠르게 사라질 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ### Physical supply and demand
segments.tr: ### 실물 수급

segments.src: Jewelry, technology and investment products all absorb gold, and mine output and recycling provide the supply.
segments.tr: 보석, 기술, 투자 상품 등은 모두 금을 소비하며, 광산 생산량과 재활용이 공급을 제공합니다.

segments.src: Demand from large buyers, covered below, can matter a great deal at the margin.
segments.tr: 아래에서 다룰 대형 구매자들의 수요는 한계점에서 매우 중요할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Who is buying
segments.tr: ## 누가 금을 사는가

segments.src: ### Central banks
segments.tr: ### 중앙은행

segments.src: Central banks have been among the most closely watched buyers in recent years.
segments.tr: 중앙은행은 최근 몇 년간 가장 면밀히 관찰되는 구매자 중 하나였습니다.

segments.src: Reasons commonly cited include:
segments.tr: 흔히 거론되는 이유는 다음과 같습니다:

segments.src: - **Diversifying reserves** away from heavy reliance on any single currency.
segments.tr: - **준비금 다변화:** 특정 통화에 대한 과도한 의존도를 낮추기 위함.

segments.src: - **Reducing exposure** to the risk that foreign-held assets could be frozen or restricted.
segments.tr: - **위험 노출 감소:** 해외 보유 자산이 동결되거나 제한될 수 있는 위험을 줄이기 위함.

segments.src: - **Adding an asset** that carries no credit risk and is hard to debase.
segments.tr: - **자산 추가:** 신용 위험이 없고 가치를 떨어뜨리기 어려운 자산을 추가하기 위함.

segments.src: Because central banks tend to buy steadily and hold for the long term, their demand can provide a firm base under the market.
segments.tr: 중앙은행은 꾸준히 매수하고 장기 보유하는 경향이 있기 때문에, 이들의 수요는 시장의 견고한 기반이 될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Their purchase plans can change, though, and the World Gold Council and the International Monetary Fund publish data that show how reserves shift over time.
segments.tr: 하지만 이들의 매수 계획은 변경될 수 있으며, 세계금협회(World Gold Council)와 국제통화기금(IMF)은 시간이 지남에 따라 준비금이 어떻게 변화하는지 보여주는 데이터를 발표합니다.

segments.src: ### Institutional and professional investors
segments.tr: ### 기관 및 전문 투자자

segments.src: Funds, pension managers and wealth advisers sometimes hold a modest slice of gold to diversify.
segments.tr: 펀드, 연금 관리자, 자산 관리자는 다변화를 위해 금을 소량 보유하기도 합니다.

segments.src: Many do so through exchange-traded funds (ETFs), which let them gain exposure without handling the metal.
segments.tr: 많은 이들이 상장지수펀드(ETF)를 통해 금을 직접 다루지 않고도 투자 노출을 확보합니다.

segments.src: ### Everyday investors
segments.tr: ### 개인 투자자

segments.src: Individual buyers come in several forms:
segments.tr: 개인 구매자는 여러 형태로 나뉩니다:

segments.src: - **Physical gold:** coins and bars, bought from dealers. Buyers should consider storage, insurance and the gap between the buying and selling price.
segments.tr: - **실물 금:** 딜러에게서 구매하는 금화와 골드바. 구매자는 보관, 보험, 매수-매도 가격 차이(스프레드)를 고려해야 합니다.

segments.src: - **Gold ETFs and similar funds:** easy to trade through a regular brokerage account, with an annual fee.
segments.tr: - **금 ETF 및 유사 펀드:** 일반 증권 계좌를 통해 쉽게 거래할 수 있으며 연간 수수료가 발생합니다.

segments.src: - **Mining company stocks:** these follow the gold price but also carry business, cost and management risks. They can swing more than gold itself.
segments.tr: - **금광 주식:** 금 가격을 따라가지만 사업, 비용, 경영 위험도 수반합니다. 금 자체보다 변동성이 클 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Jewelry:** in many cultures it doubles as both adornment and savings, though retail markups can be large.
segments.tr: - **보석:** 많은 문화권에서 장신구이자 저축 수단으로 사용되지만, 소매 마진이 클 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## What gold can do in a portfolio
segments.tr: ## 금이 포트폴리오에서 할 수 있는 역할

segments.src: - **Diversify.** Gold's price has often moved differently from stocks and bonds, which can smooth overall results.
segments.tr: - **다변화:** 금 가격은 종종 주식 및 채권과 다르게 움직여 전체적인 성과를 부드럽게 만들 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Cushion some shocks.** In certain crises, gold has risen while other assets fell, though this is not guaranteed.
segments.tr: - **충격 완화:** 특정 위기 상황에서 다른 자산이 하락할 때 금은 상승하기도 했지만, 이는 보장되지 않습니다.

segments.src: - **Offer a hedge against currency weakness** over long periods.
segments.tr: - **장기적인 통화 가치 하락에 대한 헤지 제공.**

segments.src: ## What gold can't do
segments.tr: ## 금이 할 수 없는 역할

segments.src: - **Produce income.** It pays no interest or dividends. Your return depends entirely on the price rising.
segments.tr: - **수익 창출:** 이자나 배당금을 지급하지 않습니다. 수익은 전적으로 가격 상승에 달려 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Guarantee protection.** Gold can fall at the same time as stocks, and it can decline for years. After peaking in 2011, for example, it spent several years well below that level.
segments.tr: - **보호 보장:** 금은 주식과 동시에 하락할 수 있으며, 수년간 하락할 수도 있습니다. 예를 들어 2011년 정점을 찍은 후, 수년간 그 수준을 크게 밑돌았습니다.

segments.src: - **Rise in a straight line.** Prices can be volatile, especially after strong rallies, when buying late can lock in disappointing results.
segments.tr: - **일직선으로 상승:** 가격은 변동성이 클 수 있으며, 특히 강한 상승세 이후 뒤늦게 매수하면 실망스러운 결과를 얻을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Come free of costs.** Premiums, storage, insurance, fund fees and taxes all reduce returns. Tax treatment of gold differs from that of stocks in some countries, including the U.S., where physical gold and many gold funds can be taxed as collectibles.
segments.tr: - **비용 무료:** 프리미엄, 보관, 보험, 펀드 수수료 및 세금은 모두 수익을 감소시킵니다. 금에 대한 세금 처리는 미국을 포함한 일부 국가에서 주식과 다르며, 실물 금과 많은 금 펀드는 수집품으로 과세될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Practical points to consider
segments.tr: ## 고려해야 할 실질적인 사항

segments.src: 1. **Decide the role first.** Are you seeking diversification, a hedge, or a short-term trade? The answer shapes how much, if any, to own.
segments.tr: 1. **역할을 먼저 결정하세요.** 다변화, 헤지, 단기 거래 중 무엇을 원하십니까? 그 답에 따라 보유 규모가 결정됩니다.

segments.src: 2. **Keep it proportionate.** Many financial planners suggest only a small share of a portfolio for gold, though the right amount depends on your goals, timeline and risk tolerance.
segments.tr: 2. **비중을 유지하세요.** 많은 재무 설계사는 포트폴리오에서 금의 비중을 작게 가져갈 것을 제안하지만, 적절한 규모는 목표, 기간, 위험 감수 성향에 따라 다릅니다.

segments.src: 3. **Understand what you are buying.** Know the fees, the storage arrangements and how the product tracks the gold price.
segments.tr: 3. **무엇을 사는지 이해하세요.** 수수료, 보관 방식, 해당 상품이 금 가격을 어떻게 추종하는지 파악하세요.

segments.src: 4. **Be wary of pressure.** Unsolicited offers, claims of guaranteed returns and urgent "limited time" pitches are common warning signs of fraud. Use reputable, regulated dealers and brokers.
segments.tr: 4. **압박 판매를 경계하세요.** 원치 않는 제안, 수익 보장 주장, 긴급한 "한정 기간" 홍보는 사기의 흔한 징후입니다. 평판이 좋고 규제를 받는 딜러와 브로커를 이용하세요.

segments.src: 5. **Avoid chasing headlines.** A record price makes news, but it doesn't tell you where prices go next.
segments.tr: 5. **헤드라인을 쫓지 마세요.** 기록적인 가격은 뉴스가 되지만, 가격이 다음에 어디로 갈지는 알려주지 않습니다.

segments.src: 6. **Consider professional advice** if you are unsure how gold fits your finances.
segments.tr: 6. **금 투자가 자신의 재무 상황에 맞는지 확신이 서지 않는다면 전문가의 조언을 고려하세요.**

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 결론

segments.src: Gold keeps attracting buyers because it offers something few assets do: value that doesn't rest on a promise from a government or company.
segments.tr: 금은 다른 자산이 거의 제공하지 못하는 가치, 즉 정부나 기업의 약속에 의존하지 않는 가치를 제공하기 때문에 계속해서 구매자를 끌어들입니다.

segments.src: Central banks use it to diversify reserves, and individual investors use it to balance risk.
segments.tr: 중앙은행은 준비금 다변화를 위해 금을 사용하고, 개인 투자자는 위험 균형을 맞추기 위해 금을 사용합니다.

segments.src: Still, it is neither a guaranteed shield nor a source of income.
segments.tr: 하지만 금은 보장된 방패도, 수익원도 아닙니다.

segments.src: Its price reflects interest rates, currencies, sentiment and policy, and it can fall as well as rise.
segments.tr: 금 가격은 금리, 통화, 심리, 정책을 반영하며 상승할 수도 있지만 하락할 수도 있습니다.

segments.src: Treated as one possible component of a diversified plan, and not as a bet on disaster, gold can have a place.
segments.tr: 재앙에 대한 베팅이 아니라 다변화된 계획의 한 구성 요소로 다룬다면, 금은 포트폴리오에서 자리를 차지할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Anyone considering it should weigh the costs, the risks and their own goals first.
segments.tr: 금 투자를 고려하는 사람은 먼저 비용, 위험, 그리고 자신의 목표를 따져봐야 합니다.

segments.src: *Disclaimer: This content is provided for informational purposes only and does not constitute financial advice.
segments.tr: *면책 조항: 이 콘텐츠는 정보 제공만을 목적으로 하며 재정적 조언을 구성하지 않습니다.

segments.src: Past performance does not guarantee future results.
segments.tr: 과거의 성과가 미래의 결과를 보장하지 않습니다.

segments.src: Consult a qualified professional before making investment decisions.*

zh.title: 为什么黄金持续吸引买家：央行、普通投资者与避险魅力

segments.src: Gold has stayed in the spotlight in recent years.
segments.tr: 近年来，黄金一直处于聚光灯下。

segments.src: Investors are weighing persistent inflation worries, high government debt and geopolitical tension.
segments.tr: 投资者正在衡量持续的通胀担忧、高企的政府债务以及地缘政治紧张局势。

segments.src: Each of these tends to push people toward assets they see as durable.
segments.tr: 这些因素往往都会促使人们走向他们认为耐用的资产。

segments.src: This article explains what moves the price of gold, who is buying, and what the metal can and can't do in a portfolio.
segments.tr: 本文解释了驱动金价变化的因素、谁在购买，以及这种金属在投资组合中能做什么和不能做什么。

segments.src: *This article is for general information only.
segments.tr: *本文仅供一般信息参考。

segments.src: It is not investment, tax or legal advice.*
segments.tr: 不构成投资、税务或法律建议。*

segments.src: ## Why gold is called a "safe haven"
segments.tr: ## 为什么黄金被称为“避险资产”

segments.src: A safe haven is an asset that investors expect to hold its value, or at least hold up better than most, when markets are stressed.
segments.tr: 避险资产是指当市场面临压力时，投资者预期其能够保值，或至少比大多数资产表现更好的资产。

segments.src: Gold has earned that reputation for several reasons:
segments.tr: 黄金赢得这一声誉有几个原因：

segments.src: - **It has a long history as a store of value.** Societies have used it as money and as a form of savings for thousands of years.
segments.tr: - **作为价值尺度拥有悠久的历史。** 数千年来，人类社会一直将其用作货币和储蓄形式。

segments.src: - **It is no one's liability.** A bond depends on its issuer's ability to pay. A bank deposit depends on the bank. Physical gold doesn't depend on any borrower's promise.
segments.tr: - **它不属于任何人的负债。** 债券取决于发行人的偿付能力。银行存款取决于银行。实物黄金不取决于任何借款人的承诺。

segments.src: - **Its supply grows slowly.** Mining adds only a small share to the above-ground stock each year, so it is hard to expand quickly the way a currency can be.
segments.tr: - **其供应增长缓慢。** 每年开采仅能为地上库存增加一小部分，因此很难像货币那样快速扩张。

segments.src: - **It is widely recognized.** It is traded around the clock in many countries and currencies.
segments.tr: - **它被广泛认可。** 它在许多国家和货币中全天候交易。

segments.src: The label has limits.
segments.tr: 这一标签是有局限性的。

segments.src: Gold has had long stretches, and sharp drops, when it did not behave like a haven.
segments.tr: 黄金也曾经历过长期的低迷和剧烈的下跌，在此期间它的表现并不像避险资产。

segments.src: "Safe" here means "has often held up in a crisis," not "can't lose value."
segments.tr: 这里的“安全”意味着“通常在危机中保持稳定”，而不是“绝不会贬值”。

segments.src: ## What drives the price
segments.tr: ## 驱动价格的因素

segments.src: No single factor sets the price of gold.
segments.tr: 没有单一因素决定黄金的价格。

segments.src: Analysts usually point to a handful of forces that interact.
segments.tr: 分析师通常指向相互作用的少数几种力量。

segments.src: ### Real interest rates
segments.tr: ### 实际利率

segments.src: Gold pays no interest or dividends.
segments.tr: 黄金不支付利息或股息。

segments.src: When inflation-adjusted yields on government bonds are high, holding gold has a bigger opportunity cost, and prices often come under pressure.
segments.tr: 当经过通胀调整后的国债收益率较高时，持有黄金的机会成本更大，价格往往面临压力。

segments.src: When real yields fall or turn negative, gold tends to look more attractive.
segments.tr: 当实际收益率下降或变为负值时，黄金往往看起来更有吸引力。

segments.src: ### The U.S. dollar
segments.tr: ### 美元

segments.src: Gold is priced mainly in dollars.
segments.tr: 黄金主要以美元计价。

segments.src: A weaker dollar generally makes gold cheaper for buyers using other currencies, which can lift demand.
segments.tr: 走弱的美元通常使使用其他货币的买家购买黄金更加便宜，从而推高需求。

segments.src: A stronger dollar often has the opposite effect.
segments.tr: 走强的美元往往产生相反的效果。

segments.src: The relationship is not exact, but it is a common reference point.
segments.tr: 这种关系并不是绝对的，但它是一个常见的参考点。

segments.src: ### Inflation and debt concerns
segments.tr: ### 通胀和债务担忧

segments.src: When people worry that rising prices or growing public debt could erode the purchasing power of money, some turn to gold as a hedge.
segments.tr: 当人们担心物价上涨或公共债务增加可能侵蚀货币的购买力时，一些人会转向黄金作为对冲工具。

segments.src: What matters is often the *expectation* of inflation, not the latest reading.
segments.tr: 关键往往在于对通胀的*预期*，而不是最新的数据。

segments.src: Over short periods, gold has not tracked inflation closely.
segments.tr: 在短期内，黄金并未紧密跟踪通货膨胀。

segments.src: ### Geopolitical and financial stress
segments.tr: ### 地缘政治和金融压力

segments.src: Wars, sanctions, banking scares and political uncertainty can send investors looking for assets outside the traditional financial system.
segments.tr: 战争、制裁、银行恐慌和政治不确定性会促使投资者在传统金融体系之外寻找资产。

segments.src: Demand driven by fear can arrive quickly and fade just as fast.
segments.tr: 由恐惧驱动的需求来得快，去得也同样快。

segments.src: ### Physical supply and demand
segments.tr: ### 实物供求

segments.src: Jewelry, technology and investment products all absorb gold, and mine output and recycling provide the supply.
segments.tr: 首饰、科技和投资产品都消耗黄金，而矿产产量和回收利用则提供供应。

segments.src: Demand from large buyers, covered below, can matter a great deal at the margin.
segments.tr: 大型买家的需求（如下文所述）在边际上可能起到非常重要的作用。

segments.src: ## Who is buying
segments.tr: ## 谁在购买

segments.src: ### Central banks
segments.tr: ### 中央银行

segments.src: Central banks have been among the most closely watched buyers in recent years.
segments.tr: 中央银行是近年来受关注度最高的买家之一。

segments.src: Reasons commonly cited include:
segments.tr: 经常被提及的原因包括：

segments.src: - **Diversifying reserves** away from heavy reliance on any single currency.
segments.tr: - **外汇储备多元化**，摆脱对单一货币的过度依赖。

segments.src: - **Reducing exposure** to the risk that foreign-held assets could be frozen or restricted.
segments.tr: - **降低风险敞口**，防止海外持有的资产被冻结或限制。

segments.src: - **Adding an asset** that carries no credit risk and is hard to debase.
segments.tr: - **增加一种资产**，它不带有信用风险且难以贬值。

segments.src: Because central banks tend to buy steadily and hold for the long term, their demand can provide a firm base under the market.
segments.tr: 由于中央银行倾向于稳定购买并长期持有，他们的需求可以为市场提供坚实的基础。

segments.src: Their purchase plans can change, though, and the World Gold Council and the International Monetary Fund publish data that show how reserves shift over time.
segments.tr: 不过，他们的购买计划可能会发生变化，世界黄金协会和国际货币基金组织发布的数据显示了储备随时间的变化。

segments.src: ### Institutional and professional investors
segments.tr: ### 机构和专业投资者

segments.src: Funds, pension managers and wealth advisers sometimes hold a modest slice of gold to diversify.
segments.tr: 基金、养老金管理者和财富顾问有时会持有少量黄金进行分散投资。

segments.src: Many do so through exchange-traded funds (ETFs), which let them gain exposure without handling the metal.
segments.tr: 许多人通过交易所交易基金（ETFs）进行投资，这使他们无需处理实物金属即可获得风险敞口。

segments.src: ### Everyday investors
segments.tr: ### 普通投资者

segments.src: Individual buyers come in several forms:
segments.tr: 个人买家有几种形式：

segments.src: - **Physical gold:** coins and bars, bought from dealers. Buyers should consider storage, insurance and the gap between the buying and selling price.
segments.tr: - **实物黄金：** 从交易商处购买的金条和金币。买家应考虑储存、保险以及买入价和卖出价之间的差价。

segments.src: - **Gold ETFs and similar funds:** easy to trade through a regular brokerage account, with an annual fee.
segments.tr: - **黄金 ETFs 及类似基金：** 易于通过常规证券账户交易，需支付年费。

segments.src: - **Mining company stocks:** these follow the gold price but also carry business, cost and management risks. They can swing more than gold itself.
segments.tr: - **黄金矿业公司股票：** 这些股票紧跟黄金价格，但也承担业务、成本和管理风险。它们的波动可能比黄金本身更大。

segments.src: - **Jewelry:** in many cultures it doubles as both adornment and savings, though retail markups can be large.
segments.tr: - **珠宝：** 在许多文化中，它兼具饰品和储蓄的双重功能，尽管零售溢价可能很大。

segments.src: ## What gold can do in a portfolio
segments.tr: ## 黄金在投资组合中能做什么

segments.src: - **Diversify.** Gold's price has often moved differently from stocks and bonds, which can smooth overall results.
segments.tr: - **分散投资。** 黄金价格的走势往往与股票和债券不同，这可以平滑整体投资收益。

segments.src: - **Cushion some shocks.** In certain crises, gold has risen while other assets fell, though this is not guaranteed.
segments.tr: - **缓冲部分冲击。** 在某些危机中，当其他资产下跌时，黄金出现了上涨，尽管这并不能得到保证。

segments.src: - **Offer a hedge against currency weakness** over long periods.
segments.tr: - **提供长期的货币贬值对冲**。

segments.src: ## What gold can't do
segments.tr: ## 黄金不能做什么

segments.src: - **Produce income.** It pays no interest or dividends. Your return depends entirely on the price rising.
segments.tr: - **产生收益。** 它不支付利息或股息。您的回报完全取决于价格上涨。

segments.src: - **Guarantee protection.** Gold can fall at the same time as stocks, and it can decline for years. After peaking in 2011, for example, it spent several years well below that level.
segments.tr: - **保证保护。** 黄金可能会与股票同时下跌，并且可能持续下跌数年。例如，在 2011 年达到顶峰后，它有几年的时间远低于该水平。

segments.src: - **Rise in a straight line.** Prices can be volatile, especially after strong rallies, when buying late can lock in disappointing results.
segments.tr: - **呈直线上涨。** 价格可能会剧烈波动，尤其是在强劲反弹之后，此时晚买可能会锁定令人失望的结果。

segments.src: - **Come free of costs.** Premiums, storage, insurance, fund fees and taxes all reduce returns. Tax treatment of gold differs from that of stocks in some countries, including the U.S., where physical gold and many gold funds can be taxed as collectibles.
segments.tr: - **无成本持有。** 溢价、储存、保险、基金费用和税收都会降低回报。在包括美国在内的一些国家，黄金的税务处理与股票不同，实物黄金和许多黄金基金可能会像收藏品一样被征税。

segments.src: ## Practical points to consider
segments.tr: ## 需要考虑的实用建议

segments.src: 1. **Decide the role first.** Are you seeking diversification, a hedge, or a short-term trade? The answer shapes how much, if any, to own.
segments.tr: 1. **首先明确角色。** 您是在寻求多元化、对冲还是短期交易？答案决定了拥有多少（如果有的话）。

segments.src: 2. **Keep it proportionate.** Many financial planners suggest only a small share of a portfolio for gold, though the right amount depends on your goals, timeline and risk tolerance.
segments.tr: 2. **保持适当比例。** 许多理财师建议黄金仅占投资组合的一小部分，但合适的金额取决于您的目标、时间线和风险承受能力。

segments.src: 3. **Understand what you are buying.** Know the fees, the storage arrangements and how the product tracks the gold price.
segments.tr: 3. **了解您所购买的产品。** 了解费用、储存安排以及该产品如何跟踪黄金价格。

segments.src: 4. **Be wary of pressure.** Unsolicited offers, claims of guaranteed returns and urgent "limited time" pitches are common warning signs of fraud. Use reputable, regulated dealers and brokers.
segments.tr: 4. **警惕压力。** 未经请求的推销、保证回报的言论和紧急的“限时”推销都是欺诈的常见警告信号。使用信誉良好、受监管的交易商和经纪商。

segments.src: 5. **Avoid chasing headlines.** A record price makes news, but it doesn't tell you where prices go next.
segments.tr: 5. **避免盲目追逐头条新闻。** 创纪录的价格会成为新闻，但它并不能告诉您接下来的价格走向。

segments.src: 6. **Consider professional advice** if you are unsure how gold fits your finances.
segments.tr: 6. **考虑专业建议**，如果您不确定黄金如何适应您的财务状况。

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 总结

segments.src: Gold keeps attracting buyers because it offers something few assets do: value that doesn't rest on a promise from a government or company.
segments.tr: 黄金之所以持续吸引买家，是因为它提供极少数资产能提供的东西：一种不依赖于政府或公司承诺的价值。

segments.src: Central banks use it to diversify reserves, and individual investors use it to balance risk.
segments.tr: 中央银行用它来使外汇储备多元化，个人投资者用它来平衡风险。

segments.src: Still, it is neither a guaranteed shield nor a source of income.
segments.tr: 尽管如此，它既不是有保证的盾牌，也不是收益来源。

segments.src: Its price reflects interest rates, currencies, sentiment and policy, and it can fall as well as rise.
segments.tr: 其价格反映了利率、货币、情绪和政策，可能会下跌也可能会上涨。

segments.src: Treated as one possible component of a diversified plan, and not as a bet on disaster, gold can have a place.
segments.tr: 如果将其视为多元化计划中的一个可能组成部分，而不是对灾难的下注，黄金可以占有一席之地。

segments.src: Anyone considering it should weigh the costs, the risks and their own goals first.
segments.tr: 任何考虑它的人都应该首先衡量成本、风险和他们自己的目标。

segments.tr: 在做出投资决定前，请咨询合格的专业人士。*

segments.src: ## Why gold is called a "safe haven"
segments.tr: ## सोने को "सुरक्षित ठिकाना" (सेफ हेवन) क्यों कहा जाता है

segments.src: A safe haven is an asset that investors expect to hold its value, or at least hold up better than most, when markets are stressed.
segments.tr: सुरक्षित ठिकाना (सेफ हेवन) एक ऐसी संपत्ति है जिसके बारे में निवेशकों को उम्मीद होती है कि जब बाजार दबाव में होंगे, तब भी यह अपना मूल्य बनाए रखेगी, या कम से कम अधिकांश संपत्तियों से बेहतर प्रदर्शन करेगी।

segments.src: Gold has earned that reputation for several reasons:
segments.tr: सोने ने कई कारणों से यह प्रतिष्ठा अर्जित की है:

segments.src: - **It has a long history as a store of value.** Societies have used it as money and as a form of savings for thousands of years.
segments.tr: - **मूल्य के संचय (स्टोर ऑफ वैल्यू) के रूप में इसका लंबा इतिहास रहा है।** समाजों ने हजारों वर्षों से इसका उपयोग पैसे के रूप में और बचत के एक रूप में किया है।

segments.src: - **It is no one's liability.** A bond depends on its issuer's ability to pay. A bank deposit depends on the bank. Physical gold doesn't depend on any borrower's promise.
segments.tr: - **यह किसी की देनदारी (लायबिलिटी) नहीं है।** एक बॉन्ड अपने जारीकर्ता की भुगतान करने की क्षमता पर निर्भर करता है। बैंक जमा बैंक पर निर्भर करता है। भौतिक (फिजिकल) सोना किसी भी उधारकर्ता के वादे पर निर्भर नहीं करता है।

segments.src: - **Its supply grows slowly.** Mining adds only a small share to the above-ground stock each year, so it is hard to expand quickly the way a currency can be.
segments.tr: - **इसकी आपूर्ति धीरे-धीरे बढ़ती है।** खनन से हर साल जमीन के ऊपर मौजूद कुल स्टॉक में केवल एक छोटा सा हिस्सा जुड़ता है, इसलिए इसे उस तरह जल्दी बढ़ाना मुश्किल है जैसे किसी मुद्रा (करंसी) को बढ़ाया जा सकता है।

segments.src: - **It is widely recognized.** It is traded around the clock in many countries and currencies.
segments.tr: - **यह व्यापक रूप से मान्यता प्राप्त है।** कई देशों और मुद्राओं में इसका व्यापार चौबीसों घंटे होता है।

segments.src: The label has limits.
segments.tr: इस लेबल की सीमाएं भी हैं।

segments.src: Gold has had long stretches, and sharp drops, when it did not behave like a haven.
segments.tr: सोने के इतिहास में ऐसे लंबे समय और तेज गिरावट के दौर भी रहे हैं, जब इसने सुरक्षित ठिकाने की तरह व्यवहार नहीं किया।

segments.src: "Safe" here means "has often held up in a crisis," not "can't lose value."
segments.tr: यहां "सुरक्षित" का अर्थ "संकट में अक्सर टिका रहा है" से है, न कि "इसका मूल्य कम नहीं हो सकता" से।

segments.src: ## What drives the price
segments.tr: ## सोने की कीमतों को क्या प्रभावित करता है

segments.src: No single factor sets the price of gold.
segments.tr: सोने की कीमत कोई एक कारक तय नहीं करता।

segments.src: Analysts usually point to a handful of forces that interact.
segments.tr: विश्लेषक आमतौर पर उन कुछ ताकतों की ओर इशारा करते हैं जो आपस में क्रिया करती हैं।

segments.src: ### Real interest rates
segments.tr: ### वास्तविक ब्याज दरें

segments.src: Gold pays no interest or dividends.
segments.tr: सोना कोई ब्याज या लाभांश (डिविडेंड) नहीं देता।

segments.src: When inflation-adjusted yields on government bonds are high, holding gold has a bigger opportunity cost, and prices often come under pressure.
segments.tr: जब सरकारी बॉन्ड पर मुद्रास्फीति-समायोजित रिटर्न (रियल यील्ड) अधिक होता है, तो सोना रखने की अवसर लागत (अपॉर्चुनिटी कॉस्ट) बड़ी हो जाती है, और कीमतों पर अक्सर दबाव आता है।

segments.src: When real yields fall or turn negative, gold tends to look more attractive.
segments.tr: जब वास्तविक रिटर्न गिरता है या नकारात्मक हो जाता है, तो सोना अधिक आकर्षक दिखने लगता है।

segments.src: ### The U.S. dollar
segments.tr: ### अमरीकी डॉलर

segments.src: Gold is priced mainly in dollars.
segments.tr: सोने की कीमत मुख्य रूप से डॉलर में तय की जाती है।

segments.src: A weaker dollar generally makes gold cheaper for buyers using other currencies, which can lift demand.
segments.tr: एक कमजोर डॉलर आम तौर पर अन्य मुद्राओं का उपयोग करने वाले खरीदारों के लिए सोने को सस्ता बनाता है, जिससे मांग बढ़ सकती है।

segments.src: A stronger dollar often has the opposite effect.
segments.tr: एक मजबूत डॉलर का अक्सर विपरीत प्रभाव पड़ता है।

segments.src: The relationship is not exact, but it is a common reference point.
segments.tr: यह संबंध सटीक नहीं है, लेकिन यह एक सामान्य संदर्भ बिंदु है।

segments.src: ### Inflation and debt concerns
segments.tr: ### मुद्रास्फीति और कर्ज की चिंताएं

segments.src: When people worry that rising prices or growing public debt could erode the purchasing power of money, some turn to gold as a hedge.
segments.tr: जब लोगों को चिंता होती है कि बढ़ती कीमतें या बढ़ता सार्वजनिक कर्ज पैसे की क्रय शक्ति को कम कर सकता है, तो कुछ लोग बचाव (हेज) के रूप में सोने की ओर रुख करते हैं।

segments.src: What matters is often the *expectation* of inflation, not the latest reading.
segments.tr: जो बात मायने रखती है वह अक्सर मुद्रास्फीति की *उम्मीद* होती है, न कि नवीनतम आंकड़े।

segments.src: Over short periods, gold has not tracked inflation closely.
segments.tr: कम अवधि में, सोने ने मुद्रास्फीति का निकटता से पालन नहीं किया है।

segments.src: ### Geopolitical and financial stress
segments.tr: ### भू-राजनीतिक और वित्तीय तनाव

segments.src: Wars, sanctions, banking scares and political uncertainty can send investors looking for assets outside the traditional financial system.
segments.tr: युद्ध, प्रतिबंध, बैंकिंग से जुड़ी आशंकाएं और राजनीतिक अनिश्चितता निवेशकों को पारंपरिक वित्तीय प्रणाली से बाहर संपत्तियों की तलाश करने के लिए प्रेरित कर सकती हैं।

segments.src: Demand driven by fear can arrive quickly and fade just as fast.
segments.tr: डर से प्रेरित मांग तेजी से आ सकती है और उतनी ही तेजी से गायब भी हो सकती है।

segments.src: ### Physical supply and demand
segments.tr: ### भौतिक आपूर्ति और मांग

segments.src: Jewelry, technology and investment products all absorb gold, and mine output and recycling provide the supply.
segments.tr: आभूषण, तकनीक और निवेश उत्पाद सभी सोने की खपत करते हैं, और खदान उत्पादन तथा रीसाइक्लिंग आपूर्ति प्रदान करते हैं।

segments.src: Demand from large buyers, covered below, can matter a great deal at the margin.
segments.tr: बड़े खरीदारों की मांग, जिसका नीचे उल्लेख किया गया है, सीमांत स्तर पर बहुत मायने रख सकती है।

segments.src: ## Who is buying
segments.tr: ## कौन खरीद रहा है

segments.src: ### Central banks
segments.tr: ### केंद्रीय बैंक

segments.src: Central banks have been among the most closely watched buyers in recent years.
segments.tr: हाल के वर्षों में केंद्रीय बैंक सबसे करीब से देखे जाने वाले खरीदारों में से रहे हैं।

segments.src: Reasons commonly cited include:
segments.tr: आमतौर पर बताए जाने वाले कारणों में शामिल हैं:

segments.src: - **Diversifying reserves** away from heavy reliance on any single currency.
segments.tr: - **रिजर्व का विविधतापूर्ण (डाइवर्सिफाई) निर्माण** ताकि किसी एक मुद्रा पर अत्यधिक निर्भरता न रहे।

segments.src: - **Reducing exposure** to the risk that foreign-held assets could be frozen or restricted.
segments.tr: - **जोखिम को कम करना** कि विदेश में रखी संपत्तियों को फ्रीज या प्रतिबंधित किया जा सकता है।

segments.src: - **Adding an asset** that carries no credit risk and is hard to debase.
segments.tr: - **ऐसी संपत्ति जोड़ना** जिसमें कोई क्रेडिट जोखिम न हो और जिसे अवमूल्यित करना मुश्किल हो।

segments.src: Because central banks tend to buy steadily and hold for the long term, their demand can provide a firm base under the market.
segments.tr: चूंकि केंद्रीय बैंक लगातार खरीदारी करते हैं और लंबी अवधि के लिए रखते हैं, इसलिए उनकी मांग बाजार को एक मजबूत आधार प्रदान कर सकती है।

segments.src: Their purchase plans can change, though, and the World Gold Council and the International Monetary Fund publish data that show how reserves shift over time.
segments.tr: हालांकि, उनकी खरीद योजनाएं बदल सकती हैं, और वर्ल्ड गोल्ड काउंसिल तथा अंतरराष्ट्रीय मुद्रा कोष ऐसे आंकड़े प्रकाशित करते हैं जो दिखाते हैं कि समय के साथ रिजर्व में कैसे बदलाव आता है।

segments.src: ### Institutional and professional investors
segments.tr: ### संस्थागत और पेशेवर निवेशक

segments.src: Funds, pension managers and wealth advisers sometimes hold a modest slice of gold to diversify.
segments.tr: फंड, पेंशन मैनेजर और वेल्थ एडवाइजर कभी-कभी विविधता लाने के लिए सोने का एक मामूली हिस्सा रखते हैं।

segments.src: Many do so through exchange-traded funds (ETFs), which let them gain exposure without handling the metal.
segments.tr: कई लोग ऐसा एक्सचेंज-ट्रेडेड फंड्स (ETFs) के जरिए करते हैं, जो उन्हें धातु को भौतिक रूप से संभाले बिना निवेश का अवसर देते हैं।

segments.src: ### Everyday investors
segments.tr: ### आम निवेशक

segments.src: Individual buyers come in several forms:
segments.tr: व्यक्तिगत खरीदार कई रूपों में आते हैं:

segments.src: - **Physical gold:** coins and bars, bought from dealers. Buyers should consider storage, insurance and the gap between the buying and selling price.
segments.tr: - **भौतिक सोना:** डीलरों से खरीदे गए सिक्के और बार (बिल्ट/ईंटें)। खरीदारों को भंडारण, बीमा और खरीद व बिक्री मूल्य के अंतर पर विचार करना चाहिए।

segments.src: - **Gold ETFs and similar funds:** easy to trade through a regular brokerage account, with an annual fee.
segments.tr: - **गोल्ड ETFs और समान फंड:** एक नियमित ब्रोकरेज खाते के माध्यम से व्यापार करने में आसान, एक वार्षिक शुल्क के साथ।

segments.src: - **Mining company stocks:** these follow the gold price but also carry business, cost and management risks. They can swing more than gold itself.
segments.tr: - **खनन कंपनियों के शेयर:** ये सोने की कीमत का अनुसरण करते हैं लेकिन इनमें व्यवसाय, लागत और प्रबंधन के जोखिम भी शामिल होते हैं। वे खुद सोने की तुलना में अधिक उतार-चढ़ाव दिखा सकते हैं।

segments.src: - **Jewelry:** in many cultures it doubles as both adornment and savings, though retail markups can be large.
segments.tr: - **आभूषण:** कई संस्कृतियों में यह सजावट और बचत दोनों का काम करता है, हालांकि खुदरा मार्जिन (मार्कअप) बड़ा हो सकता है।

segments.src: ## What gold can do in a portfolio
segments.tr: ## सोना पोर्टफोलियो में क्या कर सकता है

segments.src: - **Diversify.** Gold's price has often moved differently from stocks and bonds, which can smooth overall results.
segments.tr: - **विविधता लाना (डाइवर्सिफाई)।** सोने की कीमत अक्सर शेयरों और बॉन्ड से अलग तरह से बदली है, जिससे समग्र परिणाम संतुलित हो सकते हैं।

segments.src: - **Cushion some shocks.** In certain crises, gold has risen while other assets fell, though this is not guaranteed.
segments.tr: - **कुछ झटकों को कम करना।** कुछ संकटों में, अन्य संपत्तियों के गिरने पर भी सोना चढ़ा है, हालांकि इसकी कोई गारंटी नहीं है।

segments.src: - **Offer a hedge against currency weakness** over long periods.
segments.tr: - **लंबी अवधि में मुद्रा की कमजोरी के खिलाफ बचाव (हेज) प्रदान करना।**

segments.src: ## What gold can't do
segments.tr: ## सोना क्या नहीं कर सकता

segments.src: - **Produce income.** It pays no interest or dividends. Your return depends entirely on the price rising.
segments.tr: - **आय उत्पन्न करना।** यह कोई ब्याज या लाभांश नहीं देता है। आपका रिटर्न पूरी तरह से कीमत बढ़ने पर निर्भर करता है।

segments.src: - **Guarantee protection.** Gold can fall at the same time as stocks, and it can decline for years. After peaking in 2011, for example, it spent several years well below that level.
segments.tr: - **सुरक्षा की गारंटी देना।** सोना शेयरों के साथ-साथ भी गिर सकता है, और यह सालों तक निचले स्तर पर रह सकता है। उदाहरण के लिए, 2011 में अपने शिखर पर पहुंचने के बाद, इसने उस स्तर से काफी नीचे कई साल बिताए।

segments.src: - **Rise in a straight line.** Prices can be volatile, especially after strong rallies, when buying late can lock in disappointing results.
segments.tr: - **सीधी रेखा में बढ़ना।** कीमतें अस्थिर हो सकती हैं, विशेष रूप से मजबूत रैलियों के बाद, जब देर से खरीदारी करने पर निराशाजनक परिणाम मिल सकते हैं।

segments.src: - **Come free of costs.** Premiums, storage, insurance, fund fees and taxes all reduce returns. Tax treatment of gold differs from that of stocks in some countries, including the U.S., where physical gold and many gold funds can be taxed as collectibles.
segments.tr: - **बिना किसी लागत के आना।** प्रीमियम, स्टोरेज, इंश्योरेंस, फंड फीस और टैक्स सभी रिटर्न को कम करते हैं। U.S. सहित कुछ देशों में सोने पर टैक्स उपचार शेयरों से अलग होता है, जहां भौतिक सोने और कई गोल्ड फंड्स पर संग्रहणीय वस्तुओं (कलेक्टिबल्स) के रूप में कर लगाया जा सकता है।

segments.src: ## Practical points to consider
segments.tr: ## विचार करने योग्य व्यावहारिक बिंदु

segments.src: 1. **Decide the role first.** Are you seeking diversification, a hedge, or a short-term trade? The answer shapes how much, if any, to own.
segments.tr: 1. **पहले भूमिका तय करें।** क्या आप विविधीकरण, बचाव (हेजing), या अल्पकालिक व्यापार की तलाश कर रहे हैं? उत्तर यह आकार देता है कि कितना सोना रखना चाहिए, यदि कोई हो।

segments.src: 2. **Keep it proportionate.** Many financial planners suggest only a small share of a portfolio for gold, though the right amount depends on your goals, timeline and risk tolerance.
segments.tr: 2. **इसे आनुपातिक रखें।** कई वित्तीय योजनाकार पोर्टफोलियो में सोने का केवल एक छोटा सा हिस्सा रखने का सुझाव देते हैं, हालांकि सही मात्रा आपके लक्ष्यों, समय-सीमा और जोखिम सहनशीलता पर निर्भर करती है।

segments.src: 3. **Understand what you are buying.** Know the fees, the storage arrangements and how the product tracks the gold price.
segments.tr: 3. **समझें कि आप क्या खरीद रहे हैं।** शुल्क, भंडारण व्यवस्था और यह उत्पाद सोने की कीमत को कैसे ट्रैक करता है, इसके बारे में जानें।

segments.src: 4. **Be wary of pressure.** Unsolicited offers, claims of guaranteed returns and urgent "limited time" pitches are common warning signs of fraud. Use reputable, regulated dealers and brokers.
segments.tr: 4. **दबाव से सावधान रहें।** अयाचित ऑफ़र, गारंटीकृत रिटर्न के दावे और तत्काल "सीमित समय" वाले पिच धोखाधड़ी के सामान्य चेतावनी संकेत हैं। प्रतिष्ठित, विनियमित डीलरों और दलालों का उपयोग करें।

segments.src: 5. **Avoid chasing headlines.** A record price makes news, but it doesn't tell you where prices go next.
segments.tr: 5. **सुर्खियों के पीछे भागने से बचें।** एक रिकॉर्ड कीमत खबर बनती है, लेकिन यह आपको यह नहीं बताती कि कीमतें आगे कहां जाएंगी।

segments.src: 6. **Consider professional advice** if you are unsure how gold fits your finances.
segments.tr: 6. **पेशेवर सलाह पर विचार करें** यदि आप अनिश्चित हैं कि सोना आपके वित्त में कैसे फिट बैठता है।

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## अंतिम निष्कर्ष

segments.src: Gold keeps attracting buyers because it offers something few assets do: value that doesn't rest on a promise from a government or company.
segments.tr: सोना खरीदारों को आकर्षित करना जारी रखता है क्योंकि यह कुछ ऐसा प्रदान करता है जो बहुत कम संपत्तियां करती हैं: मूल्य जो किसी सरकार या कंपनी के वादे पर टिका नहीं है।

segments.src: Central banks use it to diversify reserves, and individual investors use it to balance risk.
segments.tr: केंद्रीय बैंक इसका उपयोग रिजर्व को विविधतापूर्ण बनाने के लिए करते हैं, और व्यक्तिगत निवेशक जोखिम को संतुलित करने के लिए इसका उपयोग करते हैं।

segments.src: Still, it is neither a guaranteed shield nor a source of income.
segments.tr: फिर भी, यह न तो कोई गारंटीकृत सुरक्षा कवच है और न ही आय का साधन।

segments.src: Its price reflects interest rates, currencies, sentiment and policy, and it can fall as well as rise.
segments.tr: इसकी कीमत ब्याज दरों, मुद्राओं, धारणा और नीति को दर्शाती है, और यह गिरने के साथ-साथ बढ़ भी सकती है।

segments.src: Treated as one possible component of a diversified plan, and not as a bet on disaster, gold can have a place.
segments.tr: एक विविधतापूर्ण योजना के एक संभावित घटक के रूप में देखा जाए, न कि आपदा पर दांव के रूप में, तो सोने का स्थान हो सकता है।

segments.src: Anyone considering it should weigh the costs, the risks and their own goals first.
segments.tr: इस पर विचार करने वाले किसी भी व्यक्ति को पहले लागतों, जोखिमों और अपने स्वयं के लक्ष्यों का आकलन करना चाहिए।

segments.src: *Disclaimer: This content is provided for informational purposes only and does not constitute financial advice.
segments.tr: *अस्वीकरण: यह सामग्री केवल सूचनात्मक उद्देश्यों के लिए प्रदान की गई है और यह वित्तीय सलाह नहीं है।

segments.src: Past performance does not guarantee future results.
segments.tr: अतीत का प्रदर्शन भविष्य के परिणामों की गारंटी नहीं देता है।

segments.src: Consult a qualified professional before making investment decisions.*

es.title: Por qué el oro sigue atrayendo compradores: bancos centrales, inversores particulares y el atractivo de refugio seguro

segments.src: Gold has stayed in the spotlight in recent years.
segments.tr: El oro se ha mantenido en el centro de atención durante los últimos años.

segments.src: Investors are weighing persistent inflation worries, high government debt and geopolitical tension.
segments.tr: Los inversores están evaluando las persistentes preocupaciones sobre la inflación, la elevada deuda pública y las tensiones geopolíticas.

segments.src: Each of these tends to push people toward assets they see as durable.
segments.tr: Cada uno de estos factores tiende a empujar a la gente hacia activos que consideran duraderos.

segments.src: This article explains what moves the price of gold, who is buying, and what the metal can and can't do in a portfolio.
segments.tr: Este artículo explica qué mueve el precio del oro, quién lo está comprando y qué puede y no puede hacer este metal en una cartera de inversión.

segments.src: ## Why gold is called a "safe haven"
segments.tr: ## Por qué al oro se le llama "refugio seguro"

segments.src: A safe haven is an asset that investors expect to hold its value, or at least hold up better than most, when markets are stressed.
segments.tr: Un refugio seguro es un activo del que los inversores esperan que mantenga su valor, o al menos que lo resista mejor que la mayoría, cuando los mercados están bajo tensión.

segments.src: Gold has earned that reputation for several reasons:
segments.tr: El oro se ha ganado esa reputación por varias razones:

segments.src: - **It has a long history as a store of value.** Societies have used it as money and as a form of savings for thousands of years.
segments.tr: - **Tiene un largo historial como reserva de valor.** Las sociedades lo han utilizado como dinero y como forma de ahorro durante miles de años.

segments.src: - **It is no one's liability.** A bond depends on its issuer's ability to pay. A bank deposit depends on the bank. Physical gold doesn't depend on any borrower's promise.
segments.tr: - **No es un pasivo de nadie.** Un bono depende de la capacidad de pago de su emisor. Un depósito bancario depende del banco. El oro físico no depende de la promesa de ningún prestatario.

segments.src: - **Its supply grows slowly.** Mining adds only a small share to the above-ground stock each year, so it is hard to expand quickly the way a currency can be.
segments.tr: - **Su oferta crece lentamente.** La minería añade solo una pequeña proporción al stock acumulado cada año, por lo que es difícil ampliarla rápidamente como se puede hacer con una divisa.

segments.src: - **It is widely recognized.** It is traded around the clock in many countries and currencies.
segments.tr: - **Es ampliamente reconocido.** Se negocia las 24 horas del día en muchos países y monedas.

segments.src: The label has limits.
segments.tr: Esta etiqueta tiene sus límites.

segments.src: Gold has had long stretches, and sharp drops, when it did not behave like a haven.
segments.tr: El oro ha tenido largos periodos, y caídas pronunciadas, en los que no se comportó como un refugio.

segments.src: "Safe" here means "has often held up in a crisis," not "can't lose value."
segments.tr: "Seguro" aquí significa "a menudo ha aguantado bien en una crisis", no "no puede perder valor".

segments.src: ## What drives the price
segments.tr: ## Qué impulsa su precio

segments.src: No single factor sets the price of gold.
segments.tr: Ningún factor único fija el precio del oro.

segments.src: Analysts usually point to a handful of forces that interact.
segments.tr: Los analistas suelen señalar un puñado de fuerzas que interactúan entre sí.

segments.src: ### Real interest rates
segments.tr: ### Tipos de interés reales

segments.src: Gold pays no interest or dividends.
segments.tr: El oro no paga intereses ni dividendos.

segments.src: When inflation-adjusted yields on government bonds are high, holding gold has a bigger opportunity cost, and prices often come under pressure.
segments.tr: Cuando los rendimientos de los bonos gubernamentales ajustados a la inflación son altos, mantener oro implica un mayor coste de oportunidad, y los precios suelen verse bajo presión.

segments.src: When real yields fall or turn negative, gold tends to look more attractive.
segments.tr: Cuando los rendimientos reales caen o se vuelven negativos, el oro tiende a parecer más atractivo.

segments.src: ### The U.S. dollar
segments.tr: ### El dólar estadounidense

segments.src: Gold is priced mainly in dollars.
segments.tr: El oro cotiza principalmente en dólares.

segments.src: A weaker dollar generally makes gold cheaper for buyers using other currencies, which can lift demand.
segments.tr: Un dólar más débil generalmente hace que el oro sea más barato para los compradores que usan otras monedas, lo que puede impulsar la demanda.

segments.src: A stronger dollar often has the opposite effect.
segments.tr: Un dólar más fuerte a menudo produce el efecto contrario.

segments.src: The relationship is not exact, but it is a common reference point.
segments.tr: La relación no es exacta, pero es un punto de referencia común.

segments.src: ### Inflation and debt concerns
segments.tr: ### Preocupaciones por la inflación y la deuda

segments.src: When people worry that rising prices or growing public debt could erode the purchasing power of money, some turn to gold as a hedge.
segments.tr: Cuando a la gente le preocupa que el aumento de los precios o la creciente deuda pública puedan erosionar el poder adquisitivo del dinero, algunos recurren al oro como cobertura.

segments.src: What matters is often the *expectation* of inflation, not the latest reading.
segments.tr: Lo que a menudo importa es la *expectativa* de inflación, no el último dato publicado.

segments.src: Over short periods, gold has not tracked inflation closely.
segments.tr: En periodos cortos, el oro no ha seguido de cerca a la inflación.

segments.src: ### Geopolitical and financial stress
segments.tr: ### Tensión geopolítica y financiera

segments.src: Wars, sanctions, banking scares and political uncertainty can send investors looking for assets outside the traditional financial system.
segments.tr: Las guerras, las sanciones, los sustos bancarios y la incertidumbre política pueden llevar a los inversores a buscar activos fuera del sistema financiero tradicional.

segments.src: Demand driven by fear can arrive quickly and fade just as fast.
segments.tr: La demanda impulsada por el miedo puede llegar rápidamente y desaparecer igual de rápido.

segments.src: ### Physical supply and demand
segments.tr: ### Oferta y demanda físicas

segments.src: Jewelry, technology and investment products all absorb gold, and mine output and recycling provide the supply.
segments.tr: La joyería, la tecnología y los productos de inversión absorben oro, mientras que la producción minera y el reciclaje proporcionan la oferta.

segments.src: Demand from large buyers, covered below, can matter a great deal at the margin.
segments.tr: La demanda de grandes compradores, detallada a continuación, puede influir de forma muy significativa en el margen.

segments.src: ## Who is buying
segments.tr: ## Quién está comprando

segments.src: ### Central banks
segments.tr: ### Bancos centrales

segments.src: Central banks have been among the most closely watched buyers in recent years.
segments.tr: Los bancos centrales se encuentran entre los compradores más observados de cerca en los últimos años.

segments.src: Reasons commonly cited include:
segments.tr: Entre las razones citadas habitualmente se incluyen:

segments.src: - **Diversifying reserves** away from heavy reliance on any single currency.
segments.tr: - **Diversificar reservas** reduciendo la gran dependencia de una sola moneda.

segments.src: - **Reducing exposure** to the risk that foreign-held assets could be frozen or restricted.
segments.tr: - **Reducir la exposición** al riesgo de que los activos mantenidos en el extranjero queden congelados o restringidos.

segments.src: - **Adding an asset** that carries no credit risk and is hard to debase.
segments.tr: - **Añadir un activo** que no conlleva riesgo crediticio y es difícil de devaluar.

segments.src: Because central banks tend to buy steadily and hold for the long term, their demand can provide a firm base under the market.
segments.tr: Dado que los bancos centrales tienden a comprar de forma constante y a mantener a largo plazo, su demanda puede proporcionar una base sólida al mercado.

segments.src: Their purchase plans can change, though, and the World Gold Council and the International Monetary Fund publish data that show how reserves shift over time.
segments.tr: Sin embargo, sus planes de compra pueden cambiar, y el World Gold Council y el Fondo Monetario Internacional publican datos que muestran cómo evolucionan las reservas a lo largo del tiempo.

segments.src: ### Institutional and professional investors
segments.tr: ### Inversores institucionales y profesionales

segments.src: Funds, pension managers and wealth advisers sometimes hold a modest slice of gold to diversify.
segments.tr: Los fondos, gestores de pensiones y asesores patrimoniales a veces mantienen una modesta porción de oro para diversificar.

segments.src: Many do so through exchange-traded funds (ETFs), which let them gain exposure without handling the metal.
segments.tr: Muchos lo hacen a través de fondos cotizados (ETFs), que les permiten obtener exposición sin necesidad de manipular el metal.

segments.src: ### Everyday investors
segments.tr: ### Inversores particulares

segments.src: Individual buyers come in several forms:
segments.tr: Los compradores individuales adoptan varias formas:

segments.src: - **Physical gold:** coins and bars, bought from dealers. Buyers should consider storage, insurance and the gap between the buying and selling price.
segments.tr: - **Oro físico:** monedas y lingotes, comprados a distribuidores. Los compradores deben considerar el almacenamiento, el seguro y el diferencial entre el precio de compra y de venta.

segments.src: - **Gold ETFs and similar funds:** easy to trade through a regular brokerage account, with an annual fee.
segments.tr: - **ETFs de oro y fondos similares:** fáciles de operar a través de una cuenta de corretaje habitual, con una comisión anual.

segments.src: - **Mining company stocks:** these follow the gold price but also carry business, cost and management risks. They can swing more than gold itself.
segments.tr: - **Acciones de empresas mineras:** estas siguen el precio del oro, pero también conllevan riesgos de negocio, costes y gestión. Pueden oscilar más que el propio oro.

segments.src: - **Jewelry:** in many cultures it doubles as both adornment and savings, though retail markups can be large.
segments.tr: - **Joyería:** en muchas culturas funciona tanto como adorno como de ahorro, aunque los márgenes minoristas pueden ser elevados.

segments.src: ## What gold can do in a portfolio
segments.tr: ## Qué puede hacer el oro en una cartera

segments.src: - **Diversify.** Gold's price has often moved differently from stocks and bonds, which can smooth overall results.
segments.tr: - **Diversificar.** El precio del oro a menudo se ha movido de forma diferente al de las acciones y bonos, lo que puede suavizar los resultados globales.

segments.src: - **Cushion some shocks.** In certain crises, gold has risen while other assets fell, though this is not guaranteed.
segments.tr: - **Amortiguar algunos impactos.** En ciertas crisis, el oro ha subido mientras otros activos caían, aunque esto no está garantizado.

segments.src: - **Offer a hedge against currency weakness** over long periods.
segments.tr: - **Ofrecer una cobertura contra la debilidad de las divisas** durante largos periodos.

segments.src: ## What gold can't do
segments.tr: ## Qué no puede hacer el oro

segments.src: - **Produce income.** It pays no interest or dividends. Your return depends entirely on the price rising.
segments.tr: - **Generar ingresos.** No paga intereses ni dividendos. Su rendimiento depende enteramente de que el precio suba.

segments.src: - **Guarantee protection.** Gold can fall at the same time as stocks, and it can decline for years. After peaking in 2011, for example, it spent several years well below that level.
segments.tr: - **Garantizar protección.** El oro puede caer al mismo tiempo que las acciones, y puede descender durante años. Por ejemplo, tras alcanzar su máximo en 2011, pasó varios años muy por debajo de ese nivel.

segments.src: - **Rise in a straight line.** Prices can be volatile, especially after strong rallies, when buying late can lock in disappointing results.
segments.tr: - **Subir en línea recta.** Los precios pueden ser volátiles, especialmente después de fuertes subidas, donde comprar tarde puede consolidar resultados decepcionantes.

segments.src: - **Come free of costs.** Premiums, storage, insurance, fund fees and taxes all reduce returns. Tax treatment of gold differs from that of stocks in some countries, including the U.S., where physical gold and many gold funds can be taxed as collectibles.
segments.tr: - **Estar libre de costes.** Las primas, el almacenamiento, el seguro, las comisiones de fondos y los impuestos reducen las rentabilidades. El tratamiento fiscal del oro difiere del de las acciones en algunos países, incluido EE. UU., donde el oro físico y muchos fondos de oro pueden tributar como objetos de colección.

segments.src: ## Practical points to consider
segments.tr: ## Puntos prácticos a considerar

segments.src: 1. **Decide the role first.** Are you seeking diversification, a hedge, or a short-term trade? The answer shapes how much, if any, to own.
segments.tr: 1. **Decida el papel primero.** ¿Busca diversificación, una cobertura o una operación a corto plazo? La respuesta determina cuánto tener, si es que conviene tener algo.

segments.src: 2. **Keep it proportionate.** Many financial planners suggest only a small share of a portfolio for gold, though the right amount depends on your goals, timeline and risk tolerance.
segments.tr: 2. **Manténgalo proporcionado.** Muchos planificadores financieros sugieren solo una pequeña proporción de la cartera para el oro, aunque la cantidad adecuada depende de sus objetivos, plazo y tolerancia al riesgo.

segments.src: 3. **Understand what you are buying.** Know the fees, the storage arrangements and how the product tracks the gold price.
segments.tr: 3. **Comprenda lo que está comprando.** Conozca las comisiones, los acuerdos de custodia y cómo el producto rastrea el precio del oro.

segments.src: 4. **Be wary of pressure.** Unsolicited offers, claims of guaranteed returns and urgent "limited time" pitches are common warning signs of fraud. Use reputable, regulated dealers and brokers.
segments.tr: 4. **Tenga cuidado con las presiones.** Las ofertas no solicitadas, las promesas de rentabilidades garantizadas y los discursos urgentes de "tiempo limitado" son señales de advertencia habituales de fraude. Utilice distribuidores y brókeres acreditados y regulados.

segments.src: 5. **Avoid chasing headlines.** A record price makes news, but it doesn't tell you where prices go next.
segments.tr: 5. **Evite perseguir los titulares.** Un precio récord es noticia, pero no le dice hacia dónde irán los precios a continuación.

segments.src: 6. **Consider professional advice** if you are unsure how gold fits your finances.
segments.tr: 6. **Considere el asesoramiento profesional** si no está seguro de cómo encaja el oro en sus finanzas.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## En conclusión

segments.src: Gold keeps attracting buyers because it offers something few assets do: value that doesn't rest on a promise from a government or company.
segments.tr: El oro sigue atrayendo compradores porque ofrece algo que pocos activos ofrecen: un valor que no se apoya en la promesa de un gobierno o una empresa.

segments.src: Central banks use it to diversify reserves, and individual investors use it to balance risk.
segments.tr: Los bancos centrales lo utilizan para diversificar reservas, y los inversores particulares lo usan para equilibrar el riesgo.

segments.src: Still, it is neither a guaranteed shield nor a source of income.
segments.tr: Aun así, no es ni un escudo garantizado ni una fuente de ingresos.

segments.src: Its price reflects interest rates, currencies, sentiment and policy, and it can fall as well as rise.
segments.tr: Su precio refleja tipos de interés, divisas, sentimiento y políticas económicas, y puede caer tanto como subir.

segments.src: Treated as one possible component of a diversified plan, and not as a bet on disaster, gold can have a place.
segments.tr: Tratado como un componente posible de un plan diversificado, y no como una apuesta por el desastre, el oro puede tener su lugar.

segments.src: Anyone considering it should weigh the costs, the risks and their own goals first.
segments.tr: Cualquiera que lo esté considerando debería sopesar primero los costes, los riesgos y sus propios objetivos.

segments.tr: تستوعب المجوهرات والتكنولوجيا والمنتجات الاستثمارية الذهب، بينما يقدم إنتاج المناجم وإعادة التدوير العرض.

segments.src: Demand from large buyers, covered below, can matter a great deal at the margin.
segments.tr: ويمكن للطلب من كبار المشترين، الموضح أدناه، أن يحدث فارقاً كبيراً في الهامش.

segments.src: ## Who is buying
segments.tr: ## من يشتري الذهب

segments.src: ### Central banks
segments.tr: ### البنوك المركزية

segments.src: Central banks have been among the most closely watched buyers in recent years.
segments.tr: كانت البنوك المركزية من بين أكثر المشترين متابعة في السنوات الأخيرة.

segments.src: Reasons commonly cited include:
segments.tr: وتشمل الأسباب المذكورة عادة ما يلي:

segments.src: - **Diversifying reserves** away from heavy reliance on any single currency.
segments.tr: - **تنويع الاحتياطيات** بعيداً عن الاعتماد الشديد على أي عملة واحدة.

segments.src: - **Reducing exposure** to the risk that foreign-held assets could be frozen or restricted.
segments.tr: - **تقليل التعرض** لمخاطر تجميد الأصول المملوكة في الخارج أو تقييدها.

segments.src: - **Adding an asset** that carries no credit risk and is hard to debase.
segments.tr: - **إضافة أصل** لا يحمل مخاطر ائتمانية وصعب التخفيض في قيمته.

segments.src: Because central banks tend to buy steadily and hold for the long term, their demand can provide a firm base under the market.
segments.tr: ولأن البنوك المركزية تميل إلى الشراء بثبات والاحتفاظ به للأجل الطويل، فإن طلبها يمكن أن يوفر قاعدة صلبة للسوق.

segments.src: Their purchase plans can change, though, and the World Gold Council and the International Monetary Fund publish data that show how reserves shift over time.
segments.tr: ومع ذلك، يمكن لخطة شرائها أن تتغير، وينشر مجلس الذهب العالمي وصندوق النقد الدولي بيانات تظهر كيفية تغير الاحتياطيات عبر الزمن.

segments.src: ### Institutional and professional investors
segments.tr: ### المستثمرون المؤسسيون والمحترفون

segments.src: Funds, pension managers and wealth advisers sometimes hold a modest slice of gold to diversify.
segments.tr: تحتفظ الصناديق، ومديرو صناديق التقاعد، ومستشارو الثروات أحياناً بحصة متواضعة من الذهب للتنويع.

segments.src: Many do so through exchange-traded funds (ETFs), which let them gain exposure without handling the metal.
segments.tr: ويفعل الكثير منهم ذلك من خلال الصناديق المتداولة في البورصة (ETFs)، والتي تتيح لهم الاستفادة دون التعامل الفعلي مع المعدن.

segments.src: ### Everyday investors
segments.tr: ### المستثمرون اليوميون

segments.src: Individual buyers come in several forms:
segments.tr: يأتي المشترون الأفراد في عدة أشكال:

segments.src: - **Physical gold:** coins and bars, bought from dealers. Buyers should consider storage, insurance and the gap between the buying and selling price.
segments.tr: - **الذهب المادي:** العملات والسبائك، المشتراة من التجار. ويجب على المشترين مراعاة التخزين والتأمين والفارق بين سعر الشراء وسعر البيع.

segments.src: - **Gold ETFs and similar funds:** easy to trade through a regular brokerage account, with an annual fee.
segments.tr: - **صناديق الذهب المتداولة والصناديق المشابهة:** سهلة التداول من خلال حساب وساطة عادي، مع وجود رسوم سنوية.

segments.src: - **Mining company stocks:** these follow the gold price but also carry business, cost and management risks. They can swing more than gold itself.
segments.tr: - **أسهم شركات التعدين:** تتبع هذه الأسهم سعر الذهب ولكنها تحمل أيضاً مخاطر الأعمال والتكاليف والإدارة. ويمكن أن تتأرجح أكثر من الذهب نفسه.

segments.src: - **Jewelry:** in many cultures it doubles as both adornment and savings, though retail markups can be large.
segments.tr: - **المجوهرات:** تُمثل في العديد من الثقافات زينة وادخاراً في نفس الوقت، رغم أن هوامش ربح التجزئة قد تكون كبيرة.

segments.src: ## What gold can do in a portfolio
segments.tr: ## ما الذي يمكن للذهب أن يفعله في المحفظة الاستثمارية

segments.src: - **Diversify.** Gold's price has often moved differently from stocks and bonds, which can smooth overall results.
segments.tr: - **التنويع.** غالباً ما تحرك سعر الذهب بشكل مختلف عن الأسهم والسندات، مما قد يساعد في تقليل تقلبات النتائج الإجمالية.

segments.src: - **Cushion some shocks.** In certain crises, gold has risen while other assets fell, though this is not guaranteed.
segments.tr: - **امتصاص بعض الصدمات.** في أزمات معينة، ارتفع الذهب بينما انخفضت الأصول الأخرى، رغم أن هذا غير مضمون.

segments.src: - **Offer a hedge against currency weakness** over long periods.
segments.tr: - **تقديم تحوط ضد ضعف العملة** على فترات طويلة.

segments.src: ## What gold can't do
segments.tr: ## ما لا يمكن للذهب فعله

segments.src: - **Produce income.** It pays no interest or dividends. Your return depends entirely on the price rising.
segments.tr: - **توليد دخل.** فهو لا يدفع فوائد أو أرباح أسهم. ويعتمد عائدك بالكامل على ارتفاع السعر.

segments.src: - **Guarantee protection.** Gold can fall at the same time as stocks, and it can decline for years. After peaking in 2011, for example, it spent several years well below that level.
segments.tr: - **ضمان الحماية.** يمكن أن ينخفض الذهب في نفس وقت انخفاض الأسهم، ويمكن أن يتراجع لسنوات. على سبيل المثال، بعد أن وصل إلى ذروته في عام 2011، قضي عدة سنوات أدنى بكثير من ذلك المستوى.

segments.src: - **Rise in a straight line.** Prices can be volatile, especially after strong rallies, when buying late can lock in disappointing results.
segments.tr: - **الارتفاع في خط مستقيم.** يمكن أن تكون الأسعار متقلبة، خاصة بعد الارتفاعات القوية، حيث قد يؤدي الشراء المتأخر إلى حبس نتائج مخيبة للأمل.

segments.src: - **Come free of costs.** Premiums, storage, insurance, fund fees and taxes all reduce returns. Tax treatment of gold differs from that of stocks in some countries, including the U.S., where physical gold and many gold funds can be taxed as collectibles.
segments.tr: - **أن يأتي خاليًا من التكاليف.** تقيم العلاوات والتخزين والتأمين ورسوم الصناديق والضرائب من العوائد. ويختلف المعاملة الضريبية للذهب عن الأسهم في بعض البلدان، بما في ذلك الولايات المتحدة، حيث يمكن فرض ضريبة على الذهب المادي والعديد من صناديق الذهب كمقتنيات.

segments.src: ## Practical points to consider
segments.tr: ## نقاط عملية يجب مراعاتها

segments.src: 1. **Decide the role first.** Are you seeking diversification, a hedge, or a short-term trade? The answer shapes how much, if any, to own.
segments.tr: 1. **حدد الدور أولاً.** هل تهدف إلى التنويع، أو التحوط، أو صفقات قصيرة الأجل؟ تُشكل الإجابة مقدام ما تملكه، إن وجد.

segments.src: 2. **Keep it proportionate.** Many financial planners suggest only a small share of a portfolio for gold, though the right amount depends on your goals, timeline and risk tolerance.
segments.tr: 2. **احرص على التناسب.** يقترح العديد من التخطيطيين الماليين نسبة صغيرة فقط من المحفظة للذهب، وإن كانت الكمية المناسبة تعتمد على أهدافك والجدول الزمني ومدى تحملك للمخاطر.

segments.src: 3. **Understand what you are buying.** Know the fees, the storage arrangements and how the product tracks the gold price.
segments.tr: 3. **افهم ما تشتريه.** اعرف الرسوم، وترتيبات التخزين، وكيف يتبع المنتج سعر الذهب.

segments.src: 4. **Be wary of pressure.** Unsolicited offers, claims of guaranteed returns and urgent "limited time" pitches are common warning signs of fraud. Use reputable, regulated dealers and brokers.
segments.tr: 4. **كن حذراً من الضغوط.** العروض غير المطلوبة، والادعاءات بعوائد مضمونة، والعروض العاجلة "لفترة محدودة" هي علامات تحذيرية شائعة للاحتيال. استخدم تجار ووسطاء سمعتهم جيدة ومخولين رسمياً.

segments.src: 5. **Avoid chasing headlines.** A record price makes news, but it doesn't tell you where prices go next.
segments.tr: 5. **تجنب الجري وراء العناوين الرئيسية.** السعر القياسي يصنع الأخبار، ولكنه لا يخبرك إلى أين ستتجه الأسعار بعد ذلك.

segments.src: 6. **Consider professional advice** if you are unsure how gold fits your finances.
segments.tr: 6. **فكر في الاستشارة المهنية** إذا كنت غير متأكد من كيفية ملاءمة الذهب لأمورك المالية.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## الخلاصة

segments.src: Gold keeps attracting buyers because it offers something few assets do: value that doesn't rest on a promise from a government or company.
segments.tr: يستمر الذهب في جذب المشترين لأنه يقدم شيئاً نادراً ما تقدمه الأصول الأخرى: قيمة لا تعتمد على وعد من حكومة أو شركة.

segments.src: Central banks use it to diversify reserves, and individual investors use it to balance risk.
segments.tr: تستخدمه البنوك المركزية لتنويع الاحتياطيات، ويستخدمه المستثمرون الأفراد لموازنة المخاطر.

segments.src: Still, it is neither a guaranteed shield nor a source of income.
segments.tr: ومع ذلك، فهو ليس درعاً مضموناً ولا مصدراً للدخل.

segments.src: Its price reflects interest rates, currencies, sentiment and policy, and it can fall as well as rise.
segments.tr: يعكس سعره أسعار الفائدة والعملات والمعنويات والسياسات، ويمكن أن ينخفض كما يمكن أن يرتفع.

segments.src: Treated as one possible component of a diversified plan, and not as a bet on disaster, gold can have a place.
segments.tr: إذا عومل كمكون واحد محتمل لخطة متنوعة، وليس كرهان على الكوارث، يمكن أن يكون للذهب مكان.

segments.src: Anyone considering it should weigh the costs, the risks and their own goals first.
segments.tr: وعلى أي شخص يفكر فيه أن يزن التكاليف والمخاطر وأهدافه الخاصة أولاً.

fr.title: Pourquoi l'or continue d'attirer les acheteurs : banques centrales, investisseurs particuliers et attrait de valeur refuge

segments.src: Gold has stayed in the spotlight in recent years.
segments.tr: L'or est resté sous les projecteurs ces dernières années.

segments.src: Investors are weighing persistent inflation worries, high government debt and geopolitical tension.
segments.tr: Les investisseurs pèsent les craintes persistantes d'inflation, l'endettement public élevé et les tensions géopolitiques.

segments.src: Each of these tends to push people toward assets they see as durable.
segments.tr: Chacun de ces facteurs tend à pousser les gens vers des actifs qu'ils considèrent comme durables.

segments.src: This article explains what moves the price of gold, who is buying, and what the metal can and can't do in a portfolio.
segments.tr: Cet article explique ce qui fait bouger le prix de l'or, qui achète, et ce que le métal peut et ne peut pas faire dans un portefeuille.

segments.src: *This article is for general information only.
segments.tr: *Cet article est uniquement à titre informatif.
