segments.tr: Il ne constitue pas un conseil en investissement, fiscal ou juridique.*

segments.src: ## Why gold is called a "safe haven"
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi l'or est appelé « valeur refuge »

segments.src: A safe haven is an asset that investors expect to hold its value, or at least hold up better than most, when markets are stressed.
segments.tr: Une valeur refuge est un actif dont les investisseurs attendent qu'il conserve sa valeur, ou du moins qu'il résiste mieux que la plupart, lorsque les marchés sont sous tension.

segments.src: Gold has earned that reputation for several reasons:
segments.tr: L'or a gagné cette réputation pour plusieurs raisons :

segments.src: - **It has a long history as a store of value.** Societies have used it as money and as a form of savings for thousands of years.
segments.tr: - **Il possède une longue histoire de réserve de valeur.** Les sociétés l'ont utilisé comme monnaie et comme forme d'épargne pendant des milliers d'années.

segments.src: - **It is no one's liability.** A bond depends on its issuer's ability to pay. A bank deposit depends on the bank. Physical gold doesn't depend on any borrower's promise.
segments.tr: - **Il n'est la dette de personne.** Une obligation dépend de la capacité de paiement de son émetteur. Un dépôt bancaire dépend de la banque. L'or physique ne dépend de la promesse d'aucun emprunteur.

segments.src: - **Its supply grows slowly.** Mining adds only a small share to the above-ground stock each year, so it is hard to expand quickly the way a currency can be.
segments.tr: - **Son offre croît lentement.** L'extraction minière n'ajoute chaque année qu'une petite part au stock existant, il est donc difficile de l'augmenter rapidement comme on peut le faire avec une monnaie.

segments.src: - **It is widely recognized.** It is traded around the clock in many countries and currencies.
segments.tr: - **Il est largement reconnu.** Il est négocié en permanence dans de nombreux pays et devises.

segments.src: The label has limits.
segments.tr: Cette étiquette a ses limites.

segments.src: Gold has had long stretches, and sharp drops, when it did not behave like a haven.
segments.tr: L'or a connu de longues périodes, et de fortes baisses, pendant lesquelles il ne s'est pas comporté comme une valeur refuge.

segments.src: "Safe" here means "has often held up in a crisis," not "can't lose value."
segments.tr: « Sûr » signifie ici « a souvent bien résisté pendant une crise », et non « ne peut pas perdre de valeur ».

segments.src: ## What drives the price
segments.tr: ## Ce qui détermine le prix

segments.src: No single factor sets the price of gold.
segments.tr: Aucun facteur unique ne fixe le prix de l'or.

segments.src: Analysts usually point to a handful of forces that interact.
segments.tr: Les analystes citent généralement quelques forces qui interagissent entre elles.

segments.src: ### Real interest rates
segments.tr: ### Taux d'intérêt réels

segments.src: Gold pays no interest or dividends.
segments.tr: L'or ne verse ni intérêts ni dividendes.

segments.src: When inflation-adjusted yields on government bonds are high, holding gold has a bigger opportunity cost, and prices often come under pressure.
segments.tr: Lorsque les rendements réels corrigés de l'inflation des obligations d'État sont élevés, détenir de l'or a un coût d'opportunité plus important, et les prix subissent souvent une pression à la baisse.

segments.src: When real yields fall or turn negative, gold tends to look more attractive.
segments.tr: Lorsque les rendements réels baissent ou deviennent négatifs, l'or tend à paraître plus attractif.

segments.src: ### The U.S. dollar
segments.tr: ### Le dollar américain

segments.src: Gold is priced mainly in dollars.
segments.tr: L'or est principalement libellé en dollars.

segments.src: A weaker dollar generally makes gold cheaper for buyers using other currencies, which can lift demand.
segments.tr: Un dollar plus faible rend généralement l'or moins cher pour les acheteurs utilisant d'autres devises, ce qui peut stimuler la demande.

segments.src: A stronger dollar often has the opposite effect.
segments.tr: Un dollar plus fort a souvent l'effet inverse.

segments.src: The relationship is not exact, but it is a common reference point.
segments.tr: Cette relation n'est pas exacte, mais elle constitue un point de repère courant.

segments.src: ### Inflation and debt concerns
segments.tr: ### Inquiétudes liées à l'inflation et à la dette

segments.src: When people worry that rising prices or growing public debt could erode the purchasing power of money, some turn to gold as a hedge.
segments.tr: Lorsque les gens craignent que la hausse des prix ou l'accroissement de la dette publique n'érodent le pouvoir d'achat de la monnaie, certains se tournent vers l'or comme couverture.

segments.src: What matters is often the *expectation* of inflation, not the latest reading.
segments.tr: Ce qui compte, c'est souvent l'*anticipation* d'inflation, plutôt que le dernier chiffre publié.

segments.src: Over short periods, gold has not tracked inflation closely.
segments.tr: À court terme, l'or n'a pas suivi de près l'inflation.

segments.src: ### Geopolitical and financial stress
segments.tr: ### Tensions géopolitiques et financières

segments.src: Wars, sanctions, banking scares and political uncertainty can send investors looking for assets outside the traditional financial system.
segments.tr: Les guerres, les sanctions, les crises bancaires et l'incertitude politique peuvent pousser les investisseurs à chercher des actifs en dehors du système financier traditionnel.

segments.src: Demand driven by fear can arrive quickly and fade just as fast.
segments.tr: La demande motivée par la peur peut arriver vite et disparaître tout aussi vite.

segments.src: ### Physical supply and demand
segments.tr: ### Offre et demande physiques

segments.src: Jewelry, technology and investment products all absorb gold, and mine output and recycling provide the supply.
segments.tr: La joaillerie, la technologie et les produits d'investissement absorbent tous de l'or, et la production minière ainsi que le recyclage constituent l'offre.

segments.src: Demand from large buyers, covered below, can matter a great deal at the margin.
segments.tr: La demande des grands acheteurs, présentée ci-dessous, peut peser beaucoup à la marge.

segments.src: ## Who is buying
segments.tr: ## Qui achète

segments.src: ### Central banks
segments.tr: ### Banques centrales

segments.src: Central banks have been among the most closely watched buyers in recent years.
segments.tr: Les banques centrales comptent parmi les acheteurs les plus suivis ces dernières années.

segments.src: Reasons commonly cited include:
segments.tr: Les raisons généralement citées sont notamment :

segments.src: - **Diversifying reserves** away from heavy reliance on any single currency.
segments.tr: - **Diversifier les réserves** pour ne pas dépendre fortement d'une seule devise.

segments.src: - **Reducing exposure** to the risk that foreign-held assets could be frozen or restricted.
segments.tr: - **Réduire l'exposition** au risque que des actifs détenus à l'étranger soient gelés ou restreints.

segments.src: - **Adding an asset** that carries no credit risk and is hard to debase.
segments.tr: - **Ajouter un actif** qui ne comporte aucun risque de crédit et est difficile à dévaluer.

segments.src: Because central banks tend to buy steadily and hold for the long term, their demand can provide a firm base under the market.
segments.tr: Comme les banques centrales ont tendance à acheter régulièrement et à conserver sur le long terme, leur demande peut offrir un soutien solide au marché.

segments.src: Their purchase plans can change, though, and the World Gold Council and the International Monetary Fund publish data that show how reserves shift over time.
segments.tr: Leurs plans d'achat peuvent toutefois évoluer, et le Conseil mondial de l'or ainsi que le Fonds monétaire international publient des données montrant l'évolution des réserves dans le temps.

segments.src: ### Institutional and professional investors
segments.tr: ### Investisseurs institutionnels et professionnels

segments.src: Funds, pension managers and wealth advisers sometimes hold a modest slice of gold to diversify.
segments.tr: Les fonds, les gestionnaires de retraite et les conseillers en gestion de patrimoine détiennent parfois une part modeste d'or pour diversifier.

segments.src: Many do so through exchange-traded funds (ETFs), which let them gain exposure without handling the metal.
segments.tr: Beaucoup le font par le biais de fonds négociés en bourse (ETF), qui leur permettent d'être exposés sans manipuler le métal.

segments.src: ### Everyday investors
segments.tr: ### Investisseurs particuliers

segments.src: Individual buyers come in several forms:
segments.tr: Les acheteurs particuliers se présentent sous plusieurs formes :

segments.src: - **Physical gold:** coins and bars, bought from dealers. Buyers should consider storage, insurance and the gap between the buying and selling price.
segments.tr: - **Or physique :** pièces et lingots, achetés auprès de négociants. Les acheteurs doivent tenir compte du stockage, de l'assurance et de l'écart entre le prix d'achat et le prix de vente.

segments.src: - **Gold ETFs and similar funds:** easy to trade through a regular brokerage account, with an annual fee.
segments.tr: - **ETF sur l'or et fonds similaires :** faciles à négocier via un compte de courtage classique, avec des frais annuels.

segments.src: - **Mining company stocks:** these follow the gold price but also carry business, cost and management risks. They can swing more than gold itself.
segments.tr: - **Actions de sociétés minières :** elles suivent le cours de l'or mais comportent aussi des risques liés à l'activité, aux coûts et à la gestion. Elles peuvent fluctuer davantage que l'or lui-même.

segments.src: - **Jewelry:** in many cultures it doubles as both adornment and savings, though retail markups can be large.
segments.tr: - **Bijoux :** dans de nombreuses cultures, ils servent à la fois d'ornement et d'épargne, bien que les marges de détail puissent être importantes.

segments.src: ## What gold can do in a portfolio
segments.tr: ## Ce que l'or peut apporter à un portefeuille

segments.src: - **Diversify.** Gold's price has often moved differently from stocks and bonds, which can smooth overall results.
segments.tr: - **Diversifier.** Le cours de l'or a souvent évolué différemment de celui des actions et des obligations, ce qui peut lisser les résultats globaux.

segments.src: - **Cushion some shocks.** In certain crises, gold has risen while other assets fell, though this is not guaranteed.
segments.tr: - **Amortir certains chocs.** Lors de certaines crises, l'or a monté alors que d'autres actifs baissaient, sans que cela soit garanti.

segments.src: - **Offer a hedge against currency weakness** over long periods.
segments.tr: - **Offrir une couverture contre la faiblesse des devises** sur de longues périodes.

segments.src: ## What gold can't do
segments.tr: ## Ce que l'or ne peut pas faire

segments.src: - **Produce income.** It pays no interest or dividends. Your return depends entirely on the price rising.
segments.tr: - **Produire un revenu.** Il ne verse ni intérêts ni dividendes. Votre rendement dépend entièrement de la hausse du prix.

segments.src: - **Guarantee protection.** Gold can fall at the same time as stocks, and it can decline for years. After peaking in 2011, for example, it spent several years well below that level.
segments.tr: - **Garantir une protection.** L'or peut baisser en même temps que les actions, et sa baisse peut durer des années. Après son pic de 2011, par exemple, il est resté plusieurs années nettement en dessous de ce niveau.

segments.src: - **Rise in a straight line.** Prices can be volatile, especially after strong rallies, when buying late can lock in disappointing results.
segments.tr: - **Monter en ligne droite.** Les prix peuvent être volatils, surtout après de fortes hausses, lorsqu'acheter tard peut conduire à des résultats décevants.

segments.src: - **Come free of costs.** Premiums, storage, insurance, fund fees and taxes all reduce returns. Tax treatment of gold differs from that of stocks in some countries, including the U.S., where physical gold and many gold funds can be taxed as collectibles.
segments.tr: - **Être exempt de coûts.** Primes, stockage, assurance, frais de fonds et impôts réduisent tous le rendement. Le traitement fiscal de l'or diffère de celui des actions dans certains pays, dont les États-Unis, où l'or physique et de nombreux fonds aurifères peuvent être imposés comme des objets de collection.

segments.src: ## Practical points to consider
segments.tr: ## Points pratiques à considérer

segments.src: 1. **Decide the role first.** Are you seeking diversification, a hedge, or a short-term trade? The answer shapes how much, if any, to own.
segments.tr: 1. **Définissez d'abord le rôle.** Cherchez-vous à diversifier, à vous couvrir ou à faire une opération à court terme ? La réponse détermine la quantité à détenir, voire l'opportunité d'en détenir.

segments.src: 2. **Keep it proportionate.** Many financial planners suggest only a small share of a portfolio for gold, though the right amount depends on your goals, timeline and risk tolerance.
segments.tr: 2. **Restez proportionné.** Beaucoup de planificateurs financiers suggèrent de ne consacrer qu'une petite part d'un portefeuille à l'or, même si le bon montant dépend de vos objectifs, de votre horizon et de votre tolérance au risque.

segments.src: 3. **Understand what you are buying.** Know the fees, the storage arrangements and how the product tracks the gold price.
segments.tr: 3. **Comprenez ce que vous achetez.** Connaissez les frais, les modalités de stockage et la manière dont le produit suit le cours de l'or.

segments.src: 4. **Be wary of pressure.** Unsolicited offers, claims of guaranteed returns and urgent "limited time" pitches are common warning signs of fraud. Use reputable, regulated dealers and brokers.
segments.tr: 4. **Méfiez-vous des pressions.** Les offres non sollicitées, les promesses de rendements garantis et les propositions urgentes « à durée limitée » sont des signes d'alerte courants de fraude. Faites appel à des négociants et courtiers réputés et agréés.

segments.src: 5. **Avoid chasing headlines.** A record price makes news, but it doesn't tell you where prices go next.
segments.tr: 5. **Évitez de courir après l'actualité.** Un cours record fait les gros titres, mais il ne vous indique pas où iront les prix ensuite.

segments.src: 6. **Consider professional advice** if you are unsure how gold fits your finances.
segments.tr: 6. **Demandez conseil à un professionnel** si vous ne savez pas comment l'or s'intègre à votre situation financière.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## En bref

segments.src: Gold keeps attracting buyers because it offers something few assets do: value that doesn't rest on a promise from a government or company.
segments.tr: L'or continue d'attirer les acheteurs parce qu'il offre ce que peu d'actifs offrent : une valeur qui ne repose pas sur la promesse d'un gouvernement ou d'une entreprise.

segments.src: Central banks use it to diversify reserves, and individual investors use it to balance risk.
segments.tr: Les banques centrales l'utilisent pour diversifier leurs réserves, et les investisseurs particuliers s'en servent pour équilibrer leurs risques.

segments.src: Still, it is neither a guaranteed shield nor a source of income.
segments.tr: Il n'est pourtant ni un bouclier garanti ni une source de revenu.

segments.src: Its price reflects interest rates, currencies, sentiment and policy, and it can fall as well as rise.
segments.tr: Son prix reflète les taux d'intérêt, les devises, le sentiment du marché et la politique monétaire, et il peut baisser comme monter.

segments.src: Treated as one possible component of a diversified plan, and not as a bet on disaster, gold can have a place.
segments.tr: Considéré comme un élément possible d'un plan diversifié, et non comme un pari sur une catastrophe, l'or peut avoir sa place.

segments.src: Anyone considering it should weigh the costs, the risks and their own goals first.
segments.tr: Quiconque envisage d'en acheter doit d'abord peser les coûts, les risques et ses propres objectifs.

pt.title: Por que o ouro continua atraindo compradores: bancos centrais, investidores comuns e o apelo de porto seguro

segments.src: Gold has stayed in the spotlight in recent years.
segments.tr: O ouro tem permanecido em destaque nos últimos anos.

segments.src: Investors are weighing persistent inflation worries, high government debt and geopolitical tension.
segments.tr: Os investidores estão ponderando preocupações persistentes com a inflação, a dívida pública elevada e a tensão geopolítica.

segments.src: Each of these tends to push people toward assets they see as durable.
segments.tr: Cada um desses fatores tende a levar as pessoas a buscar ativos que consideram duráveis.

segments.src: This article explains what moves the price of gold, who is buying, and what the metal can and can't do in a portfolio.
segments.tr: Este artigo explica o que move o preço do ouro, quem está comprando e o que o metal pode e não pode fazer em uma carteira.

segments.src: *This article is for general information only.
segments.tr: *Este artigo é apenas para fins informativos gerais.

segments.src: It is not investment, tax or legal advice.*
segments.tr: Não constitui aconselhamento de investimento, tributário ou jurídico.*

segments.src: ## Why gold is called a "safe haven"
segments.tr: ## Por que o ouro é chamado de "porto seguro"

segments.src: A safe haven is an asset that investors expect to hold its value, or at least hold up better than most, when markets are stressed.
segments.tr: Um porto seguro é um ativo que os investidores esperam manter seu valor, ou pelo menos se sustentar melhor do que a maioria, quando os mercados estão sob estresse.

segments.src: Gold has earned that reputation for several reasons:
segments.tr: O ouro conquistou essa reputação por diversos motivos:

segments.src: - **It has a long history as a store of value.** Societies have used it as money and as a form of savings for thousands of years.
segments.tr: - **Tem uma longa história como reserva de valor.** As sociedades o usam como dinheiro e como forma de poupança há milhares de anos.

segments.src: - **It is no one's liability.** A bond depends on its issuer's ability to pay. A bank deposit depends on the bank. Physical gold doesn't depend on any borrower's promise.
segments.tr: - **Não é a obrigação de ninguém.** Um título depende da capacidade de pagamento do emissor. Um depósito bancário depende do banco. O ouro físico não depende da promessa de nenhum tomador de empréstimo.

segments.src: - **Its supply grows slowly.** Mining adds only a small share to the above-ground stock each year, so it is hard to expand quickly the way a currency can be.
segments.tr: - **Sua oferta cresce lentamente.** A mineração acrescenta apenas uma pequena fatia ao estoque acima do solo a cada ano, por isso é difícil expandi-lo rapidamente, como acontece com uma moeda.

segments.src: - **It is widely recognized.** It is traded around the clock in many countries and currencies.
segments.tr: - **É amplamente reconhecido.** É negociado em tempo integral em muitos países e moedas.

segments.src: The label has limits.
segments.tr: O rótulo tem limites.

segments.src: Gold has had long stretches, and sharp drops, when it did not behave like a haven.
segments.tr: O ouro passou por longos períodos, e quedas acentuadas, em que não se comportou como porto seguro.

segments.src: "Safe" here means "has often held up in a crisis," not "can't lose value."
segments.tr: "Seguro" aqui significa "muitas vezes se sustentou em uma crise", não "não pode perder valor".

segments.src: ## What drives the price
segments.tr: ## O que impulsiona o preço

segments.src: No single factor sets the price of gold.
segments.tr: Nenhum fator isolado define o preço do ouro.

segments.src: Analysts usually point to a handful of forces that interact.
segments.tr: Os analistas costumam apontar um punhado de forças que interagem.

segments.src: ### Real interest rates
segments.tr: ### Juros reais

segments.src: Gold pays no interest or dividends.
segments.tr: O ouro não paga juros nem dividendos.

segments.src: When inflation-adjusted yields on government bonds are high, holding gold has a bigger opportunity cost, and prices often come under pressure.
segments.tr: Quando os rendimentos dos títulos públicos ajustados pela inflação são altos, manter ouro tem um custo de oportunidade maior, e os preços costumam sofrer pressão.

segments.src: When real yields fall or turn negative, gold tends to look more attractive.
segments.tr: Quando os juros reais caem ou ficam negativos, o ouro tende a parecer mais atraente.

segments.src: ### The U.S. dollar
segments.tr: ### O dólar americano

segments.src: Gold is priced mainly in dollars.
segments.tr: O ouro é precificado principalmente em dólares.

segments.src: A weaker dollar generally makes gold cheaper for buyers using other currencies, which can lift demand.
segments.tr: Um dólar mais fraco geralmente torna o ouro mais barato para compradores que usam outras moedas, o que pode elevar a demanda.

segments.src: A stronger dollar often has the opposite effect.
segments.tr: Um dólar mais forte costuma ter o efeito oposto.

segments.src: The relationship is not exact, but it is a common reference point.
segments.tr: A relação não é exata, mas é um ponto de referência comum.

segments.src: ### Inflation and debt concerns
segments.tr: ### Preocupações com inflação e dívida

segments.src: When people worry that rising prices or growing public debt could erode the purchasing power of money, some turn to gold as a hedge.
segments.tr: Quando as pessoas temem que a alta de preços ou o crescimento da dívida pública possa corroer o poder de compra da moeda, algumas recorrem ao ouro como proteção.

segments.src: What matters is often the *expectation* of inflation, not the latest reading.
segments.tr: O que costuma importar é a *expectativa* de inflação, e não o dado mais recente.

segments.src: Over short periods, gold has not tracked inflation closely.
segments.tr: Em períodos curtos, o ouro não acompanhou de perto a inflação.

segments.src: ### Geopolitical and financial stress
segments.tr: ### Estresse geopolítico e financeiro

segments.src: Wars, sanctions, banking scares and political uncertainty can send investors looking for assets outside the traditional financial system.
segments.tr: Guerras, sanções, crises bancárias e incerteza política podem levar investidores a buscar ativos fora do sistema financeiro tradicional.

segments.src: Demand driven by fear can arrive quickly and fade just as fast.
segments.tr: A demanda impulsionada pelo medo pode surgir rapidamente e desaparecer com a mesma velocidade.

segments.src: ### Physical supply and demand
segments.tr: ### Oferta e demanda físicas

segments.src: Jewelry, technology and investment products all absorb gold, and mine output and recycling provide the supply.
segments.tr: Joias, tecnologia e produtos de investimento absorvem ouro, e a produção das minas e a reciclagem fornecem a oferta.

segments.src: Demand from large buyers, covered below, can matter a great deal at the margin.
segments.tr: A demanda de grandes compradores, abordada abaixo, pode ter grande peso na margem.

segments.src: ## Who is buying
segments.tr: ## Quem está comprando

segments.src: ### Central banks
segments.tr: ### Bancos centrais

segments.src: Central banks have been among the most closely watched buyers in recent years.
segments.tr: Os bancos centrais têm sido, nos últimos anos, alguns dos compradores mais acompanhados de perto.

segments.src: Reasons commonly cited include:
segments.tr: Os motivos comumente citados incluem:

segments.src: - **Diversifying reserves** away from heavy reliance on any single currency.
segments.tr: - **Diversificar as reservas** para reduzir a dependência intensa de qualquer moeda única.

segments.src: - **Reducing exposure** to the risk that foreign-held assets could be frozen or restricted.
segments.tr: - **Reduzir a exposição** ao risco de que ativos mantidos no exterior sejam congelados ou restritos.

segments.src: - **Adding an asset** that carries no credit risk and is hard to debase.
segments.tr: - **Acrescentar um ativo** que não carrega risco de crédito e é difícil de desvalorizar.

segments.src: Because central banks tend to buy steadily and hold for the long term, their demand can provide a firm base under the market.
segments.tr: Como os bancos centrais tendem a comprar de forma constante e manter no longo prazo, sua demanda pode oferecer uma base firme para o mercado.

segments.src: Their purchase plans can change, though, and the World Gold Council and the International Monetary Fund publish data that show how reserves shift over time.
segments.tr: Seus planos de compra, porém, podem mudar, e o World Gold Council e o Fundo Monetário Internacional publicam dados que mostram como as reservas variam ao longo do tempo.

segments.src: ### Institutional and professional investors
segments.tr: ### Investidores institucionais e profissionais

segments.src: Funds, pension managers and wealth advisers sometimes hold a modest slice of gold to diversify.
segments.tr: Fundos, gestores de previdência e consultores de patrimônio às vezes mantêm uma parcela modesta de ouro para diversificar.

segments.src: Many do so through exchange-traded funds (ETFs), which let them gain exposure without handling the metal.
segments.tr: Muitos fazem isso por meio de fundos negociados em bolsa (ETFs), que lhes permitem ter exposição sem lidar com o metal.

segments.src: ### Everyday investors
segments.tr: ### Investidores comuns

segments.src: Individual buyers come in several forms:
segments.tr: Os compradores individuais assumem diversas formas:

segments.src: - **Physical gold:** coins and bars, bought from dealers. Buyers should consider storage, insurance and the gap between the buying and selling price.
segments.tr: - **Ouro físico:** moedas e barras, compradas de revendedores. Os compradores devem considerar armazenamento, seguro e a diferença entre o preço de compra e o de venda.

segments.src: - **Gold ETFs and similar funds:** easy to trade through a regular brokerage account, with an annual fee.
segments.tr: - **ETFs de ouro e fundos semelhantes:** fáceis de negociar por meio de uma conta de corretora comum, com taxa anual.

segments.src: - **Mining company stocks:** these follow the gold price but also carry business, cost and management risks. They can swing more than gold itself.
segments.tr: - **Ações de empresas de mineração:** acompanham o preço do ouro, mas também carregam riscos de negócio, de custos e de gestão. Podem oscilar mais do que o próprio ouro.

segments.src: - **Jewelry:** in many cultures it doubles as both adornment and savings, though retail markups can be large.
segments.tr: - **Joias:** em muitas culturas, funcionam ao mesmo tempo como adorno e poupança, embora as margens do varejo possam ser altas.

segments.src: ## What gold can do in a portfolio
segments.tr: ## O que o ouro pode fazer em uma carteira

segments.src: - **Diversify.** Gold's price has often moved differently from stocks and bonds, which can smooth overall results.
segments.tr: - **Diversificar.** O preço do ouro frequentemente se moveu de forma diferente das ações e dos títulos, o que pode suavizar o resultado geral.

segments.src: - **Cushion some shocks.** In certain crises, gold has risen while other assets fell, though this is not guaranteed.
segments.tr: - **Amortecer alguns choques.** Em certas crises, o ouro subiu enquanto outros ativos caíram, embora isso não seja garantido.

segments.src: - **Offer a hedge against currency weakness** over long periods.
segments.tr: - **Oferecer proteção contra a fraqueza da moeda** em períodos longos.

segments.src: ## What gold can't do
segments.tr: ## O que o ouro não pode fazer

segments.src: - **Produce income.** It pays no interest or dividends. Your return depends entirely on the price rising.
segments.tr: - **Gerar renda.** Não paga juros nem dividendos. Seu retorno depende inteiramente da alta do preço.

segments.src: - **Guarantee protection.** Gold can fall at the same time as stocks, and it can decline for years. After peaking in 2011, for example, it spent several years well below that level.
segments.tr: - **Garantir proteção.** O ouro pode cair ao mesmo tempo que as ações, e pode desvalorizar-se por anos. Depois de atingir o pico em 2011, por exemplo, ficou por vários anos bem abaixo desse nível.

segments.src: - **Rise in a straight line.** Prices can be volatile, especially after strong rallies, when buying late can lock in disappointing results.
segments.tr: - **Subir em linha reta.** Os preços podem ser voláteis, especialmente após fortes altas, quando comprar tarde pode resultar em resultados decepcionantes.

segments.src: - **Come free of costs.** Premiums, storage, insurance, fund fees and taxes all reduce returns. Tax treatment of gold differs from that of stocks in some countries, including the U.S., where physical gold and many gold funds can be taxed as collectibles.
segments.tr: - **Ser isento de custos.** Ágios, armazenamento, seguro, taxas de fundos e impostos reduzem o retorno. O tratamento tributário do ouro difere do das ações em alguns países, incluindo os EUA, onde o ouro físico e muitos fundos de ouro podem ser tributados como bens de colecionador.

segments.src: ## Practical points to consider
segments.tr: ## Pontos práticos a considerar

segments.src: 1. **Decide the role first.** Are you seeking diversification, a hedge, or a short-term trade? The answer shapes how much, if any, to own.
segments.tr: 1. **Defina primeiro o papel.** Você busca diversificação, proteção ou uma operação de curto prazo? A resposta define quanto, se for o caso, convém ter.

segments.src: 2. **Keep it proportionate.** Many financial planners suggest only a small share of a portfolio for gold, though the right amount depends on your goals, timeline and risk tolerance.
segments.tr: 2. **Mantenha a proporção adequada.** Muitos planejadores financeiros sugerem apenas uma pequena parcela da carteira para ouro, embora a quantidade certa dependa de seus objetivos, prazo e tolerância ao risco.

segments.src: 3. **Understand what you are buying.** Know the fees, the storage arrangements and how the product tracks the gold price.
segments.tr: 3. **Entenda o que está comprando.** Conheça as taxas, as formas de armazenamento e como o produto acompanha o preço do ouro.

segments.src: 4. **Be wary of pressure.** Unsolicited offers, claims of guaranteed returns and urgent "limited time" pitches are common warning signs of fraud. Use reputable, regulated dealers and brokers.
segments.tr: 4. **Desconfie de pressão.** Ofertas não solicitadas, promessas de retorno garantido e apelos urgentes de "oferta por tempo limitado" são sinais de alerta comuns de fraude. Use revendedores e corretoras reputados e regulamentados.

segments.src: 5. **Avoid chasing headlines.** A record price makes news, but it doesn't tell you where prices go next.
segments.tr: 5. **Evite correr atrás das manchetes.** Um preço recorde gera notícias, mas não diz para onde os preços vão em seguida.

segments.src: 6. **Consider professional advice** if you are unsure how gold fits your finances.
segments.tr: 6. **Considere buscar orientação profissional** se não tiver certeza de como o ouro se encaixa em suas finanças.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Conclusão

segments.src: Gold keeps attracting buyers because it offers something few assets do: value that doesn't rest on a promise from a government or company.
segments.tr: O ouro continua atraindo compradores porque oferece algo que poucos ativos oferecem: um valor que não depende de uma promessa de governo ou empresa.

segments.src: Central banks use it to diversify reserves, and individual investors use it to balance risk.
segments.tr: Os bancos centrais o usam para diversificar reservas, e os investidores individuais o usam para equilibrar riscos.

segments.src: Still, it is neither a guaranteed shield nor a source of income.
segments.tr: Ainda assim, ele não é um escudo garantido nem uma fonte de renda.

segments.src: Its price reflects interest rates, currencies, sentiment and policy, and it can fall as well as rise.
segments.tr: Seu preço reflete juros, moedas, sentimento e política, e pode cair tanto quanto subir.

segments.src: Treated as one possible component of a diversified plan, and not as a bet on disaster, gold can have a place.
segments.tr: Tratado como um dos possíveis componentes de um plano diversificado, e não como uma aposta em desastre, o ouro pode ter um lugar.

segments.src: Anyone considering it should weigh the costs, the risks and their own goals first.
segments.tr: Quem estiver considerando investir deve avaliar primeiro os custos, os riscos e os próprios objetivos.

segments.src: ## What drives the price

segments.src: Gold pays no interest or dividends.
segments.tr: Emas tidak memberikan bunga atau dividen.

segments.src: When inflation-adjusted yields on government bonds are high, holding gold has a bigger opportunity cost, and prices often come under pressure.
segments.tr: Ketika imbal hasil obligasi pemerintah yang disesuaikan inflasi tinggi, memegang emas memiliki biaya peluang yang lebih besar, dan harganya sering tertekan.

segments.src: When real yields fall or turn negative, gold tends to look more attractive.
segments.tr: Ketika imbal hasil riil turun atau menjadi negatif, emas cenderung terlihat lebih menarik.

segments.src: ### The U.S. dollar
segments.tr: ### Dolar AS

segments.src: Gold is priced mainly in dollars.
segments.tr: Emas terutama dihargai dalam dolar.

segments.src: A weaker dollar generally makes gold cheaper for buyers using other currencies, which can lift demand.
segments.tr: Dolar yang melemah umumnya membuat emas lebih murah bagi pembeli yang menggunakan mata uang lain, yang dapat meningkatkan permintaan.

segments.src: A stronger dollar often has the opposite effect.
segments.tr: Dolar yang menguat sering memberikan efek sebaliknya.

segments.src: The relationship is not exact, but it is a common reference point.
segments.tr: Hubungannya tidak selalu tepat, tetapi ini menjadi titik acuan yang umum.

segments.src: ### Inflation and debt concerns
segments.tr: ### Kekhawatiran inflasi dan utang

segments.src: When people worry that rising prices or growing public debt could erode the purchasing power of money, some turn to gold as a hedge.
segments.tr: Ketika orang khawatir bahwa kenaikan harga atau utang publik yang membesar dapat mengikis daya beli uang, sebagian beralih ke emas sebagai lindung nilai.

segments.src: What matters is often the *expectation* of inflation, not the latest reading.
segments.tr: Yang sering penting adalah *ekspektasi* inflasi, bukan data terbaru.

segments.src: Over short periods, gold has not tracked inflation closely.
segments.tr: Dalam periode singkat, emas tidak mengikuti inflasi dengan erat.

segments.src: ### Geopolitical and financial stress
segments.tr: ### Tekanan geopolitik dan keuangan

segments.src: Wars, sanctions, banking scares and political uncertainty can send investors looking for assets outside the traditional financial system.
segments.tr: Perang, sanksi, kepanikan perbankan, dan ketidakpastian politik dapat mendorong investor mencari aset di luar sistem keuangan tradisional.

segments.src: Demand driven by fear can arrive quickly and fade just as fast.
segments.tr: Permintaan yang didorong oleh ketakutan bisa datang dengan cepat dan juga memudar secepat itu.

segments.src: ### Physical supply and demand
segments.tr: ### Pasokan dan permintaan fisik

segments.src: Jewelry, technology and investment products all absorb gold, and mine output and recycling provide the supply.
segments.tr: Perhiasan, teknologi, dan produk investasi semuanya menyerap emas, sementara output tambang dan daur ulang menyediakan pasokan.

segments.src: Demand from large buyers, covered below, can matter a great deal at the margin.
segments.tr: Permintaan dari pembeli besar, yang dibahas di bawah, dapat sangat berpengaruh pada margin.

segments.src: ## Who is buying
segments.tr: ## Siapa yang membeli

segments.src: ### Central banks
segments.tr: ### Bank sentral

segments.src: Central banks have been among the most closely watched buyers in recent years.
segments.tr: Bank sentral telah menjadi pembeli yang paling diawasi ketat dalam beberapa tahun terakhir.

segments.src: Reasons commonly cited include:
segments.tr: Alasan yang sering dikemukakan antara lain:

segments.src: - **Diversifying reserves** away from heavy reliance on any single currency.
segments.tr: - **Mendiversifikasi cadangan** agar tidak terlalu bergantung pada satu mata uang.

segments.src: - **Reducing exposure** to the risk that foreign-held assets could be frozen or restricted.
segments.tr: - **Mengurangi paparan** terhadap risiko aset yang dipegang di luar negeri dibekukan atau dibatasi.

segments.src: - **Adding an asset** that carries no credit risk and is hard to debase.
segments.tr: - **Menambah aset** yang tidak memiliki risiko kredit dan sulit dilemahkan nilainya.

segments.src: Because central banks tend to buy steadily and hold for the long term, their demand can provide a firm base under the market.
segments.tr: Karena bank sentral cenderung membeli secara stabil dan menyimpan dalam jangka panjang, permintaan mereka dapat memberikan landasan yang kuat bagi pasar.

segments.src: Their purchase plans can change, though, and the World Gold Council and the International Monetary Fund publish data that show how reserves shift over time.
segments.tr: Namun, rencana pembelian mereka dapat berubah, dan World Gold Council serta Dana Moneter Internasional menerbitkan data yang menunjukkan bagaimana cadangan berubah dari waktu ke waktu.

segments.src: ### Institutional and professional investors
segments.tr: ### Investor institusional dan profesional

segments.src: Funds, pension managers and wealth advisers sometimes hold a modest slice of gold to diversify.
segments.tr: Dana, manajer dana pensiun, dan penasihat kekayaan terkadang memegang sebagian kecil emas untuk diversifikasi.

segments.src: Many do so through exchange-traded funds (ETFs), which let them gain exposure without handling the metal.
segments.tr: Banyak yang melakukannya melalui dana yang diperdagangkan di bursa (ETF), yang memungkinkan mereka memperoleh eksposur tanpa memegang logamnya.

segments.src: ### Everyday investors
segments.tr: ### Investor ritel

segments.src: Individual buyers come in several forms:
segments.tr: Pembeli individu datang dalam beberapa bentuk:

segments.src: - **Physical gold:** coins and bars, bought from dealers. Buyers should consider storage, insurance and the gap between the buying and selling price.
segments.tr: - **Emas fisik:** koin dan batangan, dibeli dari pedagang. Pembeli sebaiknya mempertimbangkan penyimpanan, asuransi, dan selisih antara harga beli dan harga jual.

segments.src: - **Gold ETFs and similar funds:** easy to trade through a regular brokerage account, with an annual fee.
segments.tr: - **ETF emas dan dana sejenis:** mudah diperdagangkan melalui rekening pialang biasa, dengan biaya tahunan.

segments.src: - **Mining company stocks:** these follow the gold price but also carry business, cost and management risks. They can swing more than gold itself.
segments.tr: - **Saham perusahaan tambang:** saham ini mengikuti harga emas tetapi juga membawa risiko bisnis, biaya, dan manajemen. Harganya bisa berfluktuasi lebih besar daripada emas itu sendiri.

segments.src: - **Jewelry:** in many cultures it doubles as both adornment and savings, though retail markups can be large.
segments.tr: - **Perhiasan:** di banyak budaya, perhiasan berfungsi sebagai hiasan sekaligus tabungan, meskipun markup ritel bisa sangat besar.

segments.src: ## What gold can do in a portfolio
segments.tr: ## Apa yang bisa dilakukan emas dalam portofolio

segments.src: - **Diversify.** Gold's price has often moved differently from stocks and bonds, which can smooth overall results.
segments.tr: - **Mendiversifikasi.** Harga emas sering bergerak berbeda dari saham dan obligasi, yang dapat memperhalus hasil keseluruhan.

segments.src: - **Cushion some shocks.** In certain crises, gold has risen while other assets fell, though this is not guaranteed.
segments.tr: - **Meredam sebagian guncangan.** Dalam krisis tertentu, emas naik ketika aset lain turun, meskipun hal ini tidak dijamin.

segments.src: - **Offer a hedge against currency weakness** over long periods.
segments.tr: - **Menawarkan lindung nilai terhadap melemahnya mata uang** dalam jangka panjang.

segments.src: ## What gold can't do
segments.tr: ## Apa yang tidak bisa dilakukan emas

segments.src: - **Produce income.** It pays no interest or dividends. Your return depends entirely on the price rising.
segments.tr: - **Menghasilkan pendapatan.** Emas tidak memberikan bunga atau dividen. Imbal hasil Anda sepenuhnya bergantung pada kenaikan harga.

segments.src: - **Guarantee protection.** Gold can fall at the same time as stocks, and it can decline for years. After peaking in 2011, for example, it spent several years well below that level.
segments.tr: - **Menjamin perlindungan.** Emas bisa turun bersamaan dengan saham, dan bisa merosot selama bertahun-tahun. Setelah mencapai puncak pada 2011, misalnya, harganya selama beberapa tahun berada jauh di bawah level tersebut.

segments.src: - **Rise in a straight line.** Prices can be volatile, especially after strong rallies, when buying late can lock in disappointing results.
segments.tr: - **Naik secara lurus.** Harga bisa sangat volatil, terutama setelah reli kuat, ketika membeli terlambat dapat mengunci hasil yang mengecewakan.

segments.src: - **Come free of costs.** Premiums, storage, insurance, fund fees and taxes all reduce returns. Tax treatment of gold differs from that of stocks in some countries, including the U.S., where physical gold and many gold funds can be taxed as collectibles.
segments.tr: - **Bebas dari biaya.** Premi, penyimpanan, asuransi, biaya dana, dan pajak semuanya mengurangi imbal hasil. Perlakuan pajak emas berbeda dari saham di beberapa negara, termasuk AS, tempat emas fisik dan banyak dana emas dapat dikenakan pajak sebagai barang koleksi.

segments.src: ## Practical points to consider
segments.tr: ## Poin praktis untuk dipertimbangkan

segments.src: 1. **Decide the role first.** Are you seeking diversification, a hedge, or a short-term trade? The answer shapes how much, if any, to own.
segments.tr: 1. **Tentukan perannya terlebih dahulu.** Apakah Anda mencari diversifikasi, lindung nilai, atau perdagangan jangka pendek? Jawabannya menentukan berapa banyak, jika ada, yang perlu dimiliki.

segments.src: 2. **Keep it proportionate.** Many financial planners suggest only a small share of a portfolio for gold, though the right amount depends on your goals, timeline and risk tolerance.
segments.tr: 2. **Jaga proporsinya.** Banyak perencana keuangan menyarankan hanya sebagian kecil portofolio untuk emas, meskipun jumlah yang tepat bergantung pada tujuan, jangka waktu, dan toleransi risiko Anda.

segments.src: 3. **Understand what you are buying.** Know the fees, the storage arrangements and how the product tracks the gold price.
segments.tr: 3. **Pahami apa yang Anda beli.** Ketahui biayanya, pengaturan penyimpanannya, dan bagaimana produk tersebut mengikuti harga emas.

segments.src: 4. **Be wary of pressure.** Unsolicited offers, claims of guaranteed returns and urgent "limited time" pitches are common warning signs of fraud. Use reputable, regulated dealers and brokers.
segments.tr: 4. **Waspadai tekanan.** Penawaran yang tidak diminta, klaim imbal hasil yang dijamin, dan promosi "terbatas waktu" yang mendesak adalah tanda peringatan penipuan yang umum. Gunakan pedagang dan pialang yang bereputasi dan diatur.

segments.src: 5. **Avoid chasing headlines.** A record price makes news, but it doesn't tell you where prices go next.
segments.tr: 5. **Jangan mengejar judul berita.** Harga rekor menjadi berita, tetapi tidak memberi tahu Anda ke mana harga akan bergerak berikutnya.

segments.src: 6. **Consider professional advice** if you are unsure how gold fits your finances.
segments.tr: 6. **Pertimbangkan nasihat profesional** jika Anda ragu tentang bagaimana emas cocok dengan keuangan Anda.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Kesimpulan

segments.src: Gold keeps attracting buyers because it offers something few assets do: value that doesn't rest on a promise from a government or company.
segments.tr: Emas terus menarik pembeli karena menawarkan sesuatu yang jarang dimiliki aset lain: nilai yang tidak bergantung pada janji dari pemerintah atau perusahaan.

segments.src: Central banks use it to diversify reserves, and individual investors use it to balance risk.
segments.tr: Bank sentral menggunakannya untuk mendiversifikasi cadangan, dan investor individu menggunakannya untuk menyeimbangkan risiko.

segments.src: Still, it is neither a guaranteed shield nor a source of income.
segments.tr: Meski begitu, emas bukan perisai yang dijamin maupun sumber pendapatan.

segments.src: Its price reflects interest rates, currencies, sentiment and policy, and it can fall as well as rise.
segments.tr: Harganya mencerminkan suku bunga, mata uang, sentimen, dan kebijakan, dan harganya bisa turun maupun naik.

segments.src: Treated as one possible component of a diversified plan, and not as a bet on disaster, gold can have a place.
segments.tr: Diperlakukan sebagai salah satu komponen yang mungkin dalam rencana yang terdiversifikasi, dan bukan sebagai taruhan atas bencana, emas dapat memiliki tempat.

segments.src: Anyone considering it should weigh the costs, the risks and their own goals first.
segments.tr: Siapa pun yang mempertimbangkannya sebaiknya menimbang biaya, risiko, dan tujuan pribadinya terlebih dahulu.

segments.src: Gold has stayed in the spotlight in recent years.

segments.src: This article explains what moves the price of gold, who is buying, and what the metal can and can't do in a portfolio.
segments.tr: 本記事では、金価格を動かす要因、誰が買っているのか、そして金がポートフォリオの中で何ができて何ができないのかを解説します。

segments.src: ## Why gold is called a "safe haven"
segments.tr: ## なぜ金は「安全資産」と呼ばれるのか

segments.src: A safe haven is an asset that investors expect to hold its value, or at least hold up better than most, when markets are stressed.
segments.tr: 安全資産とは、市場が不安定になったときに価値を保つ、あるいは大半の資産より持ちこたえると投資家が期待する資産です。

segments.src: Gold has earned that reputation for several reasons:
segments.tr: 金がこの評判を得ているのには、いくつかの理由があります：

segments.src: - **It has a long history as a store of value.** Societies have used it as money and as a form of savings for thousands of years.
segments.tr: - **何千年もの間、価値の保存手段として使われてきた歴史がある。** 社会は数千年にわたり、金を貨幣として、また貯蓄の一形態として用いてきました。

segments.src: - **It is no one's liability.** A bond depends on its issuer's ability to pay. A bank deposit depends on the bank. Physical gold doesn't depend on any borrower's promise.
segments.tr: - **誰の負債でもない。** 債券は発行体の支払い能力に依存し、銀行預金は銀行に依存します。現物の金は、いかなる借り手の約束にも依存しません。

segments.src: - **Its supply grows slowly.** Mining adds only a small share to the above-ground stock each year, so it is hard to expand quickly the way a currency can be.
segments.tr: - **供給はゆっくりとしか増えない。** 採掘によって毎年地上在庫に加わるのはごくわずかな割合にすぎないため、通貨のように急速に増やすことは困難です。

segments.src: - **It is widely recognized.** It is traded around the clock in many countries and currencies.
segments.tr: - **広く認知されている。** 多くの国と通貨で、24時間取引されています。

segments.src: The label has limits.
segments.tr: このラベルには限界があります。

segments.src: Gold has had long stretches, and sharp drops, when it did not behave like a haven.
segments.tr: 金には、長期間にわたる停滞期や急落期があり、その間は安全資産としての振る舞いを見せませんでした。

segments.src: "Safe" here means "has often held up in a crisis," not "can't lose value."
segments.tr: ここでの「安全」は、「危機の際にしばしば持ちこたえてきた」という意味であり、「価値を失うことがない」という意味ではありません。

segments.src: ## What drives the price
segments.tr: ## 価格を動かすもの

segments.src: No single factor sets the price of gold.
segments.tr: 金価格を決定づける単一の要因はありません。

segments.src: Analysts usually point to a handful of forces that interact.
segments.tr: アナリストは通常、相互に作用するいくつかの力を挙げます。

segments.src: ### Real interest rates
segments.tr: ### 実質金利

segments.src: Gold pays no interest or dividends.
segments.tr: 金は利息も配当も生みません。

segments.src: When inflation-adjusted yields on government bonds are high, holding gold has a bigger opportunity cost, and prices often come under pressure.
segments.tr: インフレ調整後の国債利回りが高いと、金を保有する機会費用が大きくなり、価格は下落圧力を受けることが多くなります。

segments.src: When real yields fall or turn negative, gold tends to look more attractive.
segments.tr: 実質利回りが低下したりマイナスになったりすると、金はより魅力的に見える傾向があります。

segments.src: ### The U.S. dollar
segments.tr: ### 米ドル

segments.tr: 金は主にドル建てで価格づけされます。

segments.src: A weaker dollar generally makes gold cheaper for buyers using other currencies, which can lift demand.
segments.tr: ドル安は一般的に、他通貨を使う買い手にとって金を割安にするため、需要を押し上げる可能性があります。

segments.src: A stronger dollar often has the opposite effect.

segments.src: The relationship is not exact, but it is a common reference point.
segments.tr: この関係は厳密なものではありませんが、一般的な目安となっています。

segments.src: ### Inflation and debt concerns
segments.tr: ### インフレと債務への懸念

segments.src: ### Geopolitical and financial stress
segments.tr: ### 地政学的・金融的ストレス

segments.tr: 戦争、制裁、銀行への不安、政治的不確実性によって、投資家が伝統的な金融システムの外にある資産を探し求めることがあります。

segments.src: ## Who is buying
segments.tr: ## 誰が買っているのか

segments.src: ### Central banks

segments.src: ### Institutional and professional investors
segments.tr: ### 機関投資家・プロの投資家

segments.src: ### Everyday investors

segments.src: Individual buyers come in several forms:

segments.src: ## What gold can do in a portfolio

segments.src: ## What gold can't do

segments.src: - **Produce income.** It pays no interest or dividends. Your return depends entirely on the price rising.

segments.src: - **Guarantee protection.** Gold can fall at the same time as stocks, and it can decline for years. After peaking in 2011, for example, it spent several years well below that level.

segments.src: - **Rise in a straight line.** Prices can be volatile, especially after strong rallies, when buying late can lock in disappointing results.
segments.tr: - **一直線に上昇する。** 特に強い上昇の後は価格が大きく変動することがあり、その時点で買うと期待外れの結果に終わることがあります。

segments.src: - **Come free of costs.** Premiums, storage, insurance, fund fees and taxes all reduce returns. Tax treatment of gold differs from that of stocks in some countries, including the U.S., where physical gold and many gold funds can be taxed as collectibles.

segments.src: ## Practical points to consider
segments.tr: ## 検討すべき実務上のポイント

segments.src: 1. **Decide the role first.** Are you seeking diversification, a hedge, or a short-term trade? The answer shapes how much, if any, to own.

segments.src: 2. **Keep it proportionate.** Many financial planners suggest only a small share of a portfolio for gold, though the right amount depends on your goals, timeline and risk tolerance.

segments.src: 3. **Understand what you are buying.** Know the fees, the storage arrangements and how the product tracks the gold price.

segments.src: ## The bottom line

de.title: Warum Gold Käufer anzieht: Zentralbanken, Privatanleger und die Anziehungskraft als sicherer Hafen

segments.src: Gold has stayed in the spotlight in recent years.
segments.tr: Gold stand in den letzten Jahren immer wieder im Rampenlicht.

segments.src: Investors are weighing persistent inflation worries, high government debt and geopolitical tension.
segments.tr: Anleger wägen anhaltende Inflationssorgen, hohe Staatsverschuldung und geopolitische Spannungen ab.

segments.src: Each of these tends to push people toward assets they see as durable.
segments.tr: Jede dieser Entwicklungen treibt Menschen tendenziell zu Anlagen, die sie als beständig einschätzen.

segments.tr: Dieser Artikel erklärt, was den Goldpreis bewegt, wer kauft und was das Edelmetall im Portfolio leisten kann und was nicht.

segments.tr: *Dieser Artikel dient nur allgemeinen Informationszwecken.

segments.src: ## Why gold is called a "safe haven"
segments.tr: ## Warum Gold als "sicherer Hafen" gilt

segments.src: A safe haven is an asset that investors expect to hold its value, or at least hold up better than most, when markets are stressed.
segments.tr: Ein sicherer Hafen ist eine Anlage, von der Investoren erwarten, dass sie ihren Wert behält oder sich in Stressphasen der Märkte zumindest besser hält als die meisten anderen.

segments.src: Gold has earned that reputation for several reasons:
segments.tr: Gold hat sich diesen Ruf aus mehreren Gründen verdient:

segments.src: - **It has a long history as a store of value.** Societies have used it as money and as a form of savings for thousands of years.
segments.tr: - **Es hat eine lange Geschichte als Wertspeicher.** Gesellschaften nutzen es seit Jahrtausenden als Geld und als Form der Ersparnis.

segments.src: - **It is no one's liability.** A bond depends on its issuer's ability to pay. A bank deposit depends on the bank. Physical gold doesn't depend on any borrower's promise.
segments.tr: - **Es ist niemandes Verbindlichkeit.** Eine Anleihe hängt von der Zahlungsfähigkeit ihres Emittenten ab, eine Bankeinlage von der Bank. Physisches Gold beruht auf keinem Versprechen eines Schuldners.

segments.src: - **Its supply grows slowly.** Mining adds only a small share to the above-ground stock each year, so it is hard to expand quickly the way a currency can be.
segments.tr: - **Sein Angebot wächst langsam.** Der Bergbau fügt dem oberirdischen Bestand jedes Jahr nur einen kleinen Anteil hinzu, weshalb es sich kaum so schnell vermehren lässt wie eine Währung.

segments.src: - **It is widely recognized.** It is traded around the clock in many countries and currencies.
segments.tr: - **Es ist weithin anerkannt.** Es wird in vielen Ländern und Währungen rund um die Uhr gehandelt.

segments.src: The label has limits.
segments.tr: Die Bezeichnung hat Grenzen.

segments.src: Gold has had long stretches, and sharp drops, when it did not behave like a haven.
segments.tr: Gold hatte lange Phasen und scharfe Kursrückgänge, in denen es sich nicht wie ein sicherer Hafen verhielt.

segments.src: "Safe" here means "has often held up in a crisis," not "can't lose value."
segments.tr: "Sicher" bedeutet hier "hat sich in einer Krise oft behauptet", nicht "kann keinen Wert verlieren".

segments.src: ## What drives the price
segments.tr: ## Was den Preis bestimmt

segments.src: No single factor sets the price of gold.
segments.tr: Kein einzelner Faktor bestimmt den Goldpreis.

segments.src: Analysts usually point to a handful of forces that interact.
segments.tr: Analysten verweisen in der Regel auf einige wenige Kräfte, die zusammenwirken.

segments.src: ### Real interest rates
segments.tr: ### Realzinsen

segments.src: Gold pays no interest or dividends.
segments.tr: Gold zahlt weder Zinsen noch Dividenden.

segments.src: When inflation-adjusted yields on government bonds are high, holding gold has a bigger opportunity cost, and prices often come under pressure.
segments.tr: Wenn die inflationsbereinigten Renditen von Staatsanleihen hoch sind, ist das Halten von Gold mit höheren Opportunitätskosten verbunden, und der Preis gerät oft unter Druck.

segments.src: When real yields fall or turn negative, gold tends to look more attractive.
segments.tr: Sinken die Realrenditen oder werden sie negativ, wirkt Gold meist attraktiver.

segments.src: ### The U.S. dollar
segments.tr: ### Der US-Dollar

segments.src: Gold is priced mainly in dollars.
segments.tr: Gold wird vor allem in Dollar gehandelt.

segments.src: A weaker dollar generally makes gold cheaper for buyers using other currencies, which can lift demand.
segments.tr: Ein schwächerer Dollar macht Gold für Käufer mit anderen Währungen in der Regel günstiger, was die Nachfrage stützen kann.

segments.src: A stronger dollar often has the opposite effect.
segments.tr: Ein stärkerer Dollar wirkt oft in die entgegengesetzte Richtung.

segments.src: The relationship is not exact, but it is a common reference point.
segments.tr: Der Zusammenhang ist nicht exakt, gilt aber als gängiger Bezugspunkt.

segments.src: ### Inflation and debt concerns
segments.tr: ### Inflations- und Schuldensorgen

segments.src: When people worry that rising prices or growing public debt could erode the purchasing power of money, some turn to gold as a hedge.
segments.tr: Wenn Menschen befürchten, dass steigende Preise oder wachsende Staatsschulden die Kaufkraft des Geldes aushöhlen könnten, greifen manche als Absicherung zu Gold.

segments.src: What matters is often the *expectation* of inflation, not the latest reading.
segments.tr: Entscheidend ist oft die *Erwartung* einer Inflation, nicht der jeweils neueste Messwert.

segments.src: Over short periods, gold has not tracked inflation closely.
segments.tr: Über kurze Zeiträume hat sich Gold nicht eng an die Inflation gehalten.

segments.src: ### Geopolitical and financial stress
segments.tr: ### Geopolitischer und finanzieller Stress

segments.src: Wars, sanctions, banking scares and political uncertainty can send investors looking for assets outside the traditional financial system.
segments.tr: Kriege, Sanktionen, Bankenängste und politische Unsicherheit können Anleger dazu bewegen, nach Vermögenswerten außerhalb des traditionellen Finanzsystems zu suchen.

segments.src: Demand driven by fear can arrive quickly and fade just as fast.
segments.tr: Angstgetriebene Nachfrage kann schnell entstehen und ebenso schnell wieder verschwinden.

segments.src: ### Physical supply and demand
segments.tr: ### Physisches Angebot und Nachfrage

segments.src: Jewelry, technology and investment products all absorb gold, and mine output and recycling provide the supply.
segments.tr: Schmuck, Technik und Anlageprodukte binden Gold, und die Förderung sowie das Recycling liefern das Angebot.

segments.src: Demand from large buyers, covered below, can matter a great deal at the margin.
segments.tr: Die Nachfrage großer Käufer, die unten behandelt wird, kann am Rand des Marktes sehr ins Gewicht fallen.

segments.src: ## Who is buying
segments.tr: ## Wer kauft

segments.src: ### Central banks
segments.tr: ### Zentralbanken

segments.src: Central banks have been among the most closely watched buyers in recent years.
segments.tr: Zentralbanken gehören in den letzten Jahren zu den am genauesten beobachteten Käufern.

segments.src: Reasons commonly cited include:
segments.tr: Häufig genannte Gründe sind:

segments.src: - **Diversifying reserves** away from heavy reliance on any single currency.
segments.tr: - **Diversifizierung der Reserven** weg von einer starken Abhängigkeit von einer einzelnen Währung.

segments.src: - **Reducing exposure** to the risk that foreign-held assets could be frozen or restricted.
segments.tr: - **Verringerung des Risikos**, dass im Ausland gehaltene Vermögenswerte eingefroren oder eingeschränkt werden könnten.

segments.src: - **Adding an asset** that carries no credit risk and is hard to debase.
segments.tr: - **Beimischung eines Vermögenswerts**, der kein Kreditrisiko trägt und sich nur schwer entwerten lässt.

segments.src: Because central banks tend to buy steadily and hold for the long term, their demand can provide a firm base under the market.
segments.tr: Da Zentralbanken tendenziell stetig kaufen und langfristig halten, kann ihre Nachfrage dem Markt eine feste Untergrenze geben.

segments.src: Their purchase plans can change, though, and the World Gold Council and the International Monetary Fund publish data that show how reserves shift over time.
segments.tr: Ihre Kaufpläne können sich allerdings ändern, und der World Gold Council sowie der Internationale Währungsfonds veröffentlichen Daten, die zeigen, wie sich die Reserven im Zeitverlauf verschieben.

segments.src: ### Institutional and professional investors
segments.tr: ### Institutionelle und professionelle Anleger

segments.src: Funds, pension managers and wealth advisers sometimes hold a modest slice of gold to diversify.
segments.tr: Fonds, Pensionsmanager und Vermögensberater halten zur Diversifizierung mitunter einen moderaten Anteil an Gold.

segments.src: Many do so through exchange-traded funds (ETFs), which let them gain exposure without handling the metal.
segments.tr: Viele tun dies über börsengehandelte Fonds (ETFs), mit denen sie Zugang zu Gold erhalten, ohne das Metall selbst verwahren zu müssen.

segments.src: ### Everyday investors
segments.tr: ### Privatanleger

segments.src: Individual buyers come in several forms:
segments.tr: Private Käufer treten in mehreren Formen auf:

segments.src: - **Physical gold:** coins and bars, bought from dealers. Buyers should consider storage, insurance and the gap between the buying and selling price.
segments.tr: - **Physisches Gold:** Münzen und Barren, gekauft beim Händler. Käufer sollten Lagerung, Versicherung und die Spanne zwischen Ankaufs- und Verkaufspreis berücksichtigen.

segments.src: - **Gold ETFs and similar funds:** easy to trade through a regular brokerage account, with an annual fee.
segments.tr: - **Gold-ETFs und ähnliche Fonds:** lassen sich über ein übliches Brokerkonto leicht handeln, verursachen aber eine jährliche Gebühr.

segments.src: - **Mining company stocks:** these follow the gold price but also carry business, cost and management risks. They can swing more than gold itself.
segments.tr: - **Aktien von Bergbauunternehmen:** Sie folgen dem Goldpreis, tragen aber zusätzlich Geschäfts-, Kosten- und Managementrisiken. Sie können stärker schwanken als Gold selbst.

segments.src: - **Jewelry:** in many cultures it doubles as both adornment and savings, though retail markups can be large.
segments.tr: - **Schmuck:** In vielen Kulturen dient er zugleich als Schmuck und als Ersparnis, wobei die Aufschläge im Einzelhandel hoch sein können.

segments.src: ## What gold can do in a portfolio
segments.tr: ## Was Gold im Portfolio leisten kann

segments.src: - **Diversify.** Gold's price has often moved differently from stocks and bonds, which can smooth overall results.
segments.tr: - **Diversifizieren.** Der Goldpreis hat sich oft anders entwickelt als Aktien und Anleihen, was die Gesamtergebnisse glätten kann.

segments.src: - **Cushion some shocks.** In certain crises, gold has risen while other assets fell, though this is not guaranteed.
segments.tr: - **Einige Schocks abfedern.** In bestimmten Krisen ist Gold gestiegen, während andere Anlagen fielen, dies ist allerdings nicht garantiert.

segments.src: - **Offer a hedge against currency weakness** over long periods.
segments.tr: - **Über lange Zeiträume eine Absicherung gegen Währungsschwäche bieten.**

segments.src: ## What gold can't do
segments.tr: ## Was Gold nicht kann

segments.src: - **Produce income.** It pays no interest or dividends. Your return depends entirely on the price rising.
segments.tr: - **Erträge erwirtschaften.** Es zahlt keine Zinsen und keine Dividenden. Ihre Rendite hängt vollständig davon ab, dass der Preis steigt.

segments.src: - **Guarantee protection.** Gold can fall at the same time as stocks, and it can decline for years. After peaking in 2011, for example, it spent several years well below that level.
segments.tr: - **Schutz garantieren.** Gold kann zeitgleich mit Aktien fallen und jahrelang an Wert verlieren. Nach seinem Höchststand im Jahr 2011 lag es beispielsweise mehrere Jahre deutlich darunter.

segments.src: - **Rise in a straight line.** Prices can be volatile, especially after strong rallies, when buying late can lock in disappointing results.
segments.tr: - **In gerader Linie steigen.** Die Preise können stark schwanken, besonders nach starken Kursanstiegen, wenn späte Käufe enttäuschende Ergebnisse festschreiben können.

segments.src: - **Come free of costs.** Premiums, storage, insurance, fund fees and taxes all reduce returns. Tax treatment of gold differs from that of stocks in some countries, including the U.S., where physical gold and many gold funds can be taxed as collectibles.
segments.tr: - **Kostenlos sein.** Aufgelder, Lagerung, Versicherung, Fondsgebühren und Steuern mindern alle die Rendite. Die steuerliche Behandlung von Gold weicht in einigen Ländern von der von Aktien ab, darunter in den USA, wo physisches Gold und viele Goldfonds als Sammlerobjekte besteuert werden können.

segments.src: ## Practical points to consider
segments.tr: ## Praktische Punkte zur Überlegung

segments.src: 1. **Decide the role first.** Are you seeking diversification, a hedge, or a short-term trade? The answer shapes how much, if any, to own.
segments.tr: 1. **Lege zuerst die Rolle fest.** Suchst du Diversifizierung, eine Absicherung oder einen kurzfristigen Trade? Die Antwort bestimmt, wie viel du gegebenenfalls besitzen solltest.

segments.src: 2. **Keep it proportionate.** Many financial planners suggest only a small share of a portfolio for gold, though the right amount depends on your goals, timeline and risk tolerance.
segments.tr: 2. **Halte das Verhältnis angemessen.** Viele Finanzplaner empfehlen für Gold nur einen kleinen Anteil am Portfolio, wobei die richtige Höhe von deinen Zielen, deinem Zeithorizont und deiner Risikotoleranz abhängt.

segments.src: 3. **Understand what you are buying.** Know the fees, the storage arrangements and how the product tracks the gold price.
segments.tr: 3. **Verstehe, was du kaufst.** Kenne die Gebühren, die Lagerungsbedingungen und die Art, wie das Produkt den Goldpreis abbildet.

segments.src: 4. **Be wary of pressure.** Unsolicited offers, claims of guaranteed returns and urgent "limited time" pitches are common warning signs of fraud. Use reputable, regulated dealers and brokers.
segments.tr: 4. **Sei bei Drängen vorsichtig.** Unaufgeforderte Angebote, Versprechen garantierter Renditen und dringende "nur für kurze Zeit"-Angebote sind häufige Warnzeichen für Betrug. Nutze seriöse, regulierte Händler und Broker.

segments.src: 5. **Avoid chasing headlines.** A record price makes news, but it doesn't tell you where prices go next.

segments.src: 6. **Consider professional advice** if you are unsure how gold fits your finances.
